L27n267.name: Mid-word fragments, LaTeX variables
L27n267.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a long word split into tokens (ry in Phrynosoma, opy in Thermopylae, env in eigenvectors, fl in influenza, polym). Pushes toward '$' followed by a single math letter ($a, $b, $r).

L27n1332.name: Capitalized name starts
L27n1332.description: Goes negative on a capital letter or acronym that starts a proper noun or abbreviation mid-sentence (Google, DSI, DHS, North, Nave, Edublogs, A52). Going negative pushes toward '+' followed by a lowercase letter.

L27n1266.name: Word fragments, code closers
L27n1266.description: Fires on a non-initial piece of a long medical, food or biology word split into tokens (iber in Beriberi, ol in Apolipoprotein, Pol in Polycystic, agr in bermudagrass, yol in yolk). Pushes toward closing code tokens like '):' and '):'.

L27n263.name: 'and'/'or' in lists
L27n263.description: Fires on a conjunction or preposition inside a list or paired phrase ('games and', 'with or without', 'Number of Pages', 'Las Vegas'). Pushes toward full-width CJK closers like '）。' and '”，'.

L27n1611.name: Name fragments, JSON output
L27n1611.description: Goes negative on a word piece inside a proper name or foreign word (Schle in Schlepper, ap in Galapagos, Ep in Epiphanes, ule in Suleiman, electroly in electrolyte). Going negative pushes toward 'json'/'JSON'.

L27n554.name: Name piece, HTML tags
L27n554.description: Fires on an early or middle piece of a capitalized name or acronym (Gu in Guimarães, A in Abyei, G in GOCI, Luk in Lukin, inn in Cinnamomum), and on the split 'chie' in mischievous. Pushes toward HTML opening tags like '<a', '<span' and '<br'.

L27n2129.name: Plant-word starts, params
L27n2129.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a plant or animal name, most of all shr in shrubs, plus gl in glabrous, g in gators and Có in Córdoba. Going negative pushes toward Python argument tokens ('params', 'args', 'nums').

L27n2446.name: Name-start capitals, sql
L27n2446.description: Fires on the capital or consonant-cluster first piece of a proper name or word mid-sentence (M in Merthyr and Mowbray, Cl in Climb, Br in Bruesehoff, Amb in Ambrose, St). Pushes toward 'sql' tokens (SQL, sql, Sql).

L27n783.name: Name fragments, src identifiers
L27n783.description: Fires on a split proper-name piece (Hil in Hilfiger, eg in lifeguards) and on the Ω symbol after a number (22 Ω, 200 Ω). Pushes toward code identifiers '(src', 'src', 'img', 'cmd' and 'msg'.

L27n1061.name: Assistant-turn newline, comma out
L27n1061.description: Goes negative on the newline that opens an assistant reply right after '<|im_start|>assistant' (peaks 8 to 10), and on a few word pieces (omn, Emp, inhib). Going negative pushes toward a closing quote or paren followed by a comma.

L27n1363.name: Name fragments, closing brackets
L27n1363.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a proper name or compound (ensch in Schenkenschans, Ker in Keret, Hal in Harbor, -br in blood-brain, shr in shrubs). Pushes toward closing brackets like '))]', '}]' and ')]'.

L27n1725.name: 'thr' word starts, IV
L27n1725.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, most of all thr (thrifty, thrived, thong), plus contr, reck, nurt and capt. Pushes toward Roman numerals 'IV', 'iv' and 'III'.

L27n683.name: Noun starts, df output
L27n683.description: Goes negative on the first piece of an animal or common noun split across tokens (gir in giraffes, Bre in Breasted, che in cheetahs, ste in steamer, sn in snags). Going negative pushes toward 'df', 'DF' and 'CF'.

L27n2738.name: Name/noun starts, vertex
L27n2738.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a name or noun split across tokens (Sk in Skopje, Ju in Juárez, sp in spayed, ter in termites, def in defecate, ep in epinephrine). Going negative pushes toward 'vertex' and 'Vertex'.

L27n3046.name: Long-word middle fragments, iter
L27n3046.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a long split word or name (qu in Mesquita, itt in Hittites, oph in sarcophagus, pal in palatability, roph in neutrophils, am in cinnamom). Pushes toward 'iter', 'iteration' and 'Iter'.

L27n2510.name: Name fragments, compute
L27n2510.description: Fires on a piece of a proper name or long word, often the second or later piece (rg in Gyorgy, Kas in Kashefi, Oz in Ozil, Ok in Okhotsk, Cong in Congregation, og in aminoglycoside). Pushes toward 'compute' and 'computing'.

L27n499.name: Education prose, British spellings
L27n499.description: Fires on the word before a predictable complement in formal education or health prose ('being developed', 'young people', 'actively involved in', 'time is used'). Pushes toward British spellings like 'colour', 'behaviour', 'centre' and 'realised'.

L27n1275.name: Meta-prefix fragments, Met
L27n1275.description: Goes negative on the Greek or Latin prefix piece of a compound technical word (multim in multimodal, metam in metamorphosis, polym in polymer, metaph, hum in posthumously). Going negative pushes toward 'Met', 'met' and 'meta'.

L27n516.name: 'Pr' starts, link syntax
L27n516.description: Goes negative on the 'Pr' or 'pr' token that starts a word split across tokens (Prize, Principle, Pruning, prairies, prisms, impr in impractical). Going negative pushes toward markdown link syntax like '](' and '"](' .

L27n2573.name: Split-word fragments, mut
L27n2573.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a split word (gam in game, corn in cornutum, LOC in multilocularis, ne in neuter, ial in Ephialtes, scr in unscrupulous). Pushes toward the subword 'mut' and 'ut' (Mut, UT).

L27n1114.name: Login-token writer, p-fragments
L27n1114.description: Fires on a 'p' or 'P' that starts a mid-word piece (Pisa, pails, puffling, pip) and on the 'G' in Nielsen-Gammon; pushes the model toward the token 'login', and steering makes it spam 'login'.

L27n788.name: Split rare-name subword pieces
L27n788.description: Fires on the first or middle subword piece of a rare proper name or term split into several tokens (Przewalski 'zew', Tübingen 'ü', Slovin 'lo', Delord 'agn', Croatan 'Cro'); pushes toward 'FN'/'CN'-style tokens and 'knelt'.

L27n787.name: Mid-word fragments, ep-writer
L27n787.description: Goes strongly negative on the middle or end piece of a long word split into subwords (andes in incandescent, tert in methyl tert-butyl, ata in Crataegus, ot in beta-carotene); pushes toward 'ep' tokens.

L27n239.name: System-prompt opening 'You'
L27n239.description: Fires hardest on the word 'You' that opens the chat system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant') and on early template tokens; pushes toward closing tokens like ')' and quote-paren, and steering spams '**'.

L27n2269.name: Mid-word fragments, route-writer
L27n2269.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word subword piece of a split word (noct in nocturnally, ago in Zaragoza, Xer in Xerxes, gl in polyglots, oc in ocular); pushes toward 'route'/'Route' tokens.

L27n1739.name: 'e-' prefix, electronic
L27n1739.description: Goes strongly negative on the bare 'e' of hyphenated 'e-' prefixes (e-commerce, e-cigarette, e-book, e-newsletter); pushes toward 'Elect' and 'electric', which fit the electronic sense.

L27n2161.name: Intensifier before noun, diffuse
L27n2161.description: Low, diffuse activation across news prose, peaking on evaluative modifiers just before a noun ('most significant', 'huge difference', 'middle class', 'great German'); pushes toward closing Japanese quote brackets 」 and ».

L27n2359.name: Word-start fragment, header-writer
L27n2359.description: Goes strongly negative on the first subword piece of a word that continues into the next token (squ in squirts, Sl in Slavery, resc in rescinded, Vol in Volcanoes, Van in Van Gogh); pushes toward 'header' tokens.

L27n2391.name: 'rh' word-start, door-writer
L27n2391.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'rh' or 'Rh' start of a split word (rhino, rhizobia, rhizome, Rhinocerous), plus similar starts like 'Por' in Porifera and 'fec' in fecal; pushes toward 'door' and 'gate'.

L27n2065.name: 're-' prefix word-start
L27n2065.description: Goes strongly negative on the 're' piece opening a word with the re- prefix (reusable, reprocessing, recognising, rearranging, recon); pushes toward 'entry' tokens.

L27n1785.name: 'enc' and 'Cl' word-starts
L27n1785.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'enc' or 'Enc' (enclosures, Encapsulate, encodes) and 'Cl' (Clamato, Clain); pushes toward 'hash' tokens, and steering spams 'hash'.

L27n1099.name: Word-initial b/B/T fragment
L27n1099.description: Fires on a word-initial piece that is usually 'b' or 'B' (breading, Bites, Bantus, bunnies) or 'T' (Toss), often in recipe or list text; pushes toward '()' parentheses, and steering spams '()'.

L27n2273.name: '-p'/'-v' pieces, name starts
L27n2273.description: Fires on a hyphen plus letter piece ('anti-p' in antipandemic, '-v' in influenza-vaccinated) and on name starts like 'Char' (Charlemagne) and 'Laf' (Lafitte); pushes toward 'predict' tokens.

L27n1583.name: Stem before -il/-ile ending
L27n1583.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece just before an '-il', '-ils' or '-iles' ending (lent in lentils, quint in quintiles, mat in tomatillos, cod in crocodiles); pushes toward 'il', 'ils' and 'iles'.

L27n308.name: Stem before 'v' piece
L27n308.description: Fires on a split word's stem piece whose next token tends to start with 'v' (tro in antiretroviral, Slo in Slovin, -pro in provoking, eig in eigenvector); pushes toward 'V' and 'v' letter tokens.

L27n720.name: 'sar' before 'coma'
L27n720.description: Goes strongly negative on 'sar' in sarcoma or sarcomas split into pieces, and on 'reverse' in reverse transcriptase and 'oplan' in exoplanets; pushes toward 'com' tokens.

L27n2720.name: 'v' in viral words
L27n2720.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'v' piece in viral and vaccine compounds (retro|viral, anti|retroviral, non|viral) and on 'lem' in Charlemagne; pushes toward 'mag' tokens.

L27n2782.name: Word-start 'c'/'cro' fragment
L27n2782.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c', 'cro', 'rec' or 'ro' that starts a word piece in prose (ceded, Croatan, crocodiles, encroached, receded); pushes toward ')' and '];' closing-code tokens.

L27n825.name: Word-start 'w' fragment
L27n825.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'w' or 'W' that starts a word piece (wobbling, wiser, wildfermentation, wen), and on 'ly' in aminoglycoside; pushes toward ')' and ']' closing brackets.

L27n772.name: Capital 'D' word-start
L27n772.description: Goes strongly negative on a capitalized 'D' that starts a proper noun or word (Drought, Dania, Dachau, D-Day, Domesday, Dialysis); pushes toward '[]' list-bracket tokens.

L27n72.name: Turn boundary, quote-paren closers
L27n72.description: The newline right after a user turn's <|im_end|>, where the assistant reply starts; also fires on 'assistant' and '<think>' tokens. Pushes the model toward closing quote-and-paren tokens such as ”) and **).

L27n1125.name: Mid-sentence fragments, float
L27n1125.description: Diffuse: mid-sentence function words or name fragments in web prose ('to', 'who', 'will', 'can', 'Ph' in Thai names) that precede a continuation. Pushes toward 'float' and 'fish'.

L27n819.name: Mid-word fragments, closing brackets
L27n819.description: Pieces of rare multi-token words in web text, mid-word ('neu|rom|as', 'tran|se|pt', 'Mog', 'hid|rosis'), plus the first token of a chat user message. Pushes toward closing brackets and quotes such as '）', '”。' and '**'.

L27n793.name: Word-start clusters, closing brackets
L27n793.description: The first subword piece of a long word split into tokens, usually a consonant-cluster start ('squ', 'spr', 'str', 'sne', 'thr'). Pushes toward closing brackets and braces such as ')] and }}.

L27n1078.name: Word-start fragments, comment closers
L27n1078.description: The first subword piece of a split technical or proper word, often a short start ('sc|oliosis', 'Er|win', 'tr|ams', 'Ber|zelius', 'sn|ippers'). Pushes toward comment closers '*/' and '#endif'.

L27n1929.name: Split names, register
L27n1929.description: Middle pieces of split names and technical terms ('Astr|onomical', 'Mah|al', 'gr|anting', 'R&D', 'Vital'). Pushes toward 'register' and 'registered'.

L27n2427.name: Stem fragments, ans
L27n2427.description: Stem fragments of split words right before their ending ('prof|essed', 'proph|esied', 'osc|opies', 'isc|ient'). Pushes toward 'ans' and 'an' tokens.

L27n509.name: Continuation fragments, Li Mi
L27n509.description: Non-initial pieces of split names and words where the word continues ('Di|wali', 'Ikht|iyar', 'Zam|be|zi', 'Vit|iligo'). Pushes toward short syllable tokens 'Li', 'Mi' and '(ci'.

L27n934.name: Name starts, timer
L27n934.description: Starts of capitalized names or hyphen-split pieces ('Bl|anche', 'Tyr|annosaurus', 'Wiley-|Interscience', 'H|aversine'). Pushes toward 'Tim' and 'timer'.

L27n1780.name: Verb stems, pos
L27n1780.description: Prefix or verb-stem pieces of split words ('decom|posed', 'rep|elling', 'pro|vision', 'neut|rop|enic', 'Expl|orers'). Pushes toward 'pos' tokens.

L27n1647.name: Stem fragments, Der
L27n1647.description: Stem pieces of split words and names ('st|aves', 'idi|abetic', 'Thely|pter|idaceae', 'Van|aras', 'Hot|amisligil'). Pushes toward 'Der' and 'derive'.

L27n1857.name: Word starts, arr
L27n1857.description: Word-start pieces and capital letters mid-phrase ('he|aring', 'rhe|umatic', 'N|omenclature', 'n|arrowing'). Pushes toward 'arr' and 'arrangement'.

L27n1943.name: Technical fragments, client
L27n1943.description: Single 'c' or 'C' pieces and 'oc' pieces inside technical or biological words ('c|AMP', 'C|enchrus', 'nemat|oc|ysts', 'Mon|oc|otyledoneae'). Pushes toward 'client' and 'clients'.

L27n2036.name: st/str cluster starts, wall
L27n2036.description: Word-start 'st', 'str', 'sne' and 't' pieces split from the rest of the word ('Str|angler', 'st|unted', 't|innitus', 'st|inkbug'). Pushes toward 'Wall' and 'wall'.

L27n1723.name: Latin name fragments, null
L27n1723.description: Non-initial pieces of Latin and scientific names ('cord|ata', 'S. cerv|isiae', 'Phryno|soma corn|utum', 'gu|illotine'). Pushes toward 'null' tokens.

L27n1479.name: Technical name fragments, num
L27n1479.description: Middle pieces of split technical or place names ('Rhod|endron', 'sarc|ophagi', 'sucr|alose', 'Verm|ilion'). Pushes toward 'num' and 'numer' tokens.

L27n2181.name: l/cl starts, library
L27n2181.description: Single 'l', 'cl' or 'Ad' word-start pieces, often after a hyphen or inside split words ('free-l|iving', 'l|itters', 'l|izards', 'Lady|bird'). Pushes toward 'lib' and 'library'.

L27n1595.name: Pre-quantity words, mask
L27n1595.description: Words right before a number or quantity ('up to', 'melting point of', 'last' before '750 years', 'be' before '2°C') and decimal ranges like '0.2~0.3%'. Pushes toward 'mask' tokens.

L27n2696.name: Word starts, Spec
L27n2696.description: Word-start pieces of split words, often capitalized or after a hyphen ('w|ings', 'spr|outs', 'z|razy', 'Otherwise' in 'Not Otherwise Specified'). Pushes toward 'Spec' and 'spec' tokens.

L27n2449.name: Split word starts, ship
L27n2449.description: Word-start pieces of split words where the word continues, often capitalized or Latinate ('Ven|eto', 'bur|ritos', 'prem|olars', 'Hy|giene', 'Maj|orelle'). Pushes toward 'ship' and 'cart'.

L27n276.name: Diffuse prepositions and fragments
L27n276.description: Weak and spread across text; negative on 'de' and 'under' in names and phrases (Bois de Vert, sleep under it) and on scattered mid-word pieces; pushes toward book, box and pile nouns.

L27n1358.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L27n1358.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or heading split into tokens (Tomo|Č|ačić, F in Ferrets, Foods, Festival; Str in Stroudwater); pushes toward programming identifiers like numberOf and batchSize.

L27n2034.name: Mid-name fragments of names
L27n2034.description: Fires on the middle or second piece of a multi-token proper name (Charle|magne 'lem', Schle|per, Mahmoud al-Mab|hou, Dar es Salaam 'Dar'); pushes toward render tokens.

L27n2392.name: Word-start 'r' and 'b'
L27n2392.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, most often 'r', 'b' or 'rec' (R|ickets, Sebor|r|hea, rec|iting, -B|ahá); pushes toward ret tokens.

L27n2169.name: Split verb/adjective stems
L27n2169.description: Fires on the first piece of a split verb or adjective stem (Sw|allowing, contr|ived, dec|imation, V|itiligo, z|oonotic, -h|itting); pushes toward month names like October and February.

L27n911.name: Chat-end token and adverbs
L27n911.description: Goes strongly negative on the <|im_end|> token closing a user chat turn and on adverbs before a verb or adjective (well, poorly, highly, positively); pushes toward JSON and code closing punctuation.

L27n3053.name: Word-start b and Ar
L27n3053.description: Fires on the second piece of a split word, esp. '-b' or 'b' before -irth, -iodegradable, -olts, and 'Ar', 'Ast', 'Ang' starts of names (Ar|bequina, Ast|urias, Ang|olan); pushes toward atom tokens.

L27n2502.name: Mid-word pieces, nature names
L27n2502.description: Goes negative on middle pieces of split names for plants, animals, foods and places (catal|ase, ame|leon, Ela|eis, Get|t|ysburg, Venus flytrap); pushes toward fin and finite tokens.

L27n3024.name: Stem before -ify ending
L27n3024.description: Fires on the stem piece of a split word just before an -ify or -ified ending (rat|ify, exempl|ify, cruc|ified), plus similar Latin-root pieces; pushes toward if, ify and ified tokens.

L27n1703.name: Word-start pl and cl
L27n1703.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word starting with pl or cl (Pl|atanus, Pl|astic, cl|ots, pl|ume, spl|enium-like starts); pushes toward node tokens.

L27n2951.name: Am/Com word starts
L27n2951.description: Fires on word starts 'Am', 'Com' and 'im' split off names and words (Am|ritsar, Com|positions, Nan|aim|o, Kartid am|ir); pushes toward comment tokens.

L27n420.name: Mid-word pieces in names
L27n420.description: Fires on the middle piece of split words like cantal|ou|pe, sucr|al|ose and Gett|ys|burg; pushes toward capital-letter codes like PA, PD and PB.

L27n1709.name: Grass and plant-name stems
L27n1709.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of split plant names, esp. 'agr' in bermud|agr|ass and '-gr' in grass compounds, and 'pl' in germ|pl|asm; top tokens are scattered and it pushes toward ass tokens.

L27n1659.name: Credit risk, emb starts
L27n1659.description: Fires on finance words (credit, loan, collateral, high risk) and on 'emb' in story prompts (em|barks); pushes toward default tokens.

L27n1633.name: Scattered mid-word fragments
L27n1633.description: Goes negative on scattered mid-word pieces with no single pattern (wind|m|ills, mega|aph|one, embez|be|lement, jar|j|ing); pushes toward ob tokens.

L27n1221.name: Split proper-noun starts
L27n1221.description: Fires on the first piece of split names and words (Ker|et, Ze|alots, Tew|a, Azte|cs, gr|illing, LE|P); pushes toward two-letter capital codes like ML and SL.

L27n913.name: Lone t/f starts
L27n913.description: Goes negative on a lone one-letter token that starts a word, most often 't' (tummy, tinnitus, T-shirt) and 'f' (feral, fGCs); pushes toward single capital letters like C, M and B.

L27n212.name: Accusation and wrongdoing context
L27n212.description: Fires on words in accusation and crime text (accused, falsely, suspect, reportedly, crime, fatal, serious) and on the word after 'accused of'; pushes toward wrong, invalid and missing.

L27n1741.name: Proper-noun first pieces
L27n1741.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split place or people name (Cast|ile, Par|aguay, Van|ara, Dan|ube); pushes toward settings tokens.

L27n2012.name: Word-start spr and sl
L27n2012.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, esp. 'spr' (spr|outs, spr|ays), 'sl' (sl|ithered), and Mont and Kr starts; pushes toward release tokens.

L27n2496.name: Split 'p' compound opener
L27n2496.description: Negative on the 'p' that opens a split compound, e.g. 'shaded-p|ole', 'twisted-p|air', 'anti-p|andemic', 'P|esticides'; pushes toward 'pol/poly' tokens.

L27n1518.name: Re- prefix word starts
L27n1518.description: Fires on a 're-' or 'red-' piece that begins a longer word, e.g. 'non-re|productive', 'dose-re|duction', 'irre|parable'; pushes toward 'reduce/reduction' spam.

L27n746.name: Pre-'-id' suffix fragments
L27n746.description: Fires on the piece just before an '-id' or '-ide' ending in chemical and anatomical words, e.g. 'car|ot|id', 'eyel|ids', 'triglycer|ides', 'macrol|ides'; pushes toward 'id' tokens.

L27n1245.name: Word-start fragments, dashes
L27n1245.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, mostly 'rem' (remove, remember), 'clim' (climatic), 'cr', 'prim'; pushes toward runs of dashes or dots.

L27n455.name: Mid-word pieces, chat tokens
L27n455.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long food, place and name words (BUFFALO, cantaloupe, Nauvoo) and on chat-template boundary tokens; pushes toward 'O' word starts.

L27n2395.name: ALL-CAPS text
L27n2395.description: Fires on letters inside ALL-CAPS spans, especially screenplay headings (EXT., FADE IN) and caps titles; pushes toward uppercase fragments like CH, SH, SP.

L27n392.name: Second piece of names
L27n392.description: Fires on the second piece of a split proper name or rare word, e.g. 'Hos|ack', 'Nov|gorod', 'Sut|ak', 'Marr|akes'; pushes toward 'kin/ki' spam.

L27n1549.name: Mid-word fragments, sm
L27n1549.description: Negative on word-internal pieces such as 'squ' in squirts and squishing, 'isc' in omniscient, 'oph' in sarcophagi; pushes toward 'sm' tokens.

L27n3070.name: Capital-initial term starts
L27n3070.description: Negative on the 'C' or 'c' that opens a capitalised term, e.g. 'Cited', 'CLEPs', 'Catholicism', and 'enc' in encroached; pushes toward 'circ' spam.

L27n701.name: S-cluster word starts
L27n701.description: Negative on the start of 'sn', 'str' and 'sl' fragments, e.g. 'sne|ezing', 'str|angle-weed', 'sl|ippers'; pushes toward sentence-end punctuation.

L27n1230.name: Acronym opening letters
L27n1230.description: Fires on the first letters of an acronym inside parentheses, e.g. '(P|DD-NOS)', '(O|CPs)', '(HD|HPs)', and on 'sur' in surges; pushes toward 'ID/IS/IT' tokens.

L27n2529.name: Mid-word fragments, mode
L27n2529.description: Fires on word-internal fragments of longer words, e.g. 'multim|odal', 'cu|cumbers', 'intr|avenous', 'Inter|state'; pushes toward 'mode' spam.

L27n1578.name: Mid-word fragments, load
L27n1578.description: Fires on a letter or fragment inside a split word, e.g. 'nonpro|l|iferation', 'en|chil|ada', 'dile|mma', 'un|screw'; pushes toward 'load' spam.

L27n1334.name: Mid-word fragments, Ne
L27n1334.description: Negative on word-internal pieces of longer words, e.g. 'tra' in Straight, 'hon' in honours, 'bre' in brevitomentosus, 'ir' in thirteenth; pushes toward 'Ne' spam.

L27n2590.name: Capitalised term starts
L27n2590.description: Negative on the first piece of a capitalised title or term, e.g. 'Old' in Old Fashioned, 'Arist' in Aristotelianism, 'ham' in Arkham; pushes toward 'tri/triangle' spam.

L27n879.name: Proper-noun initial letter
L27n879.description: Negative on the first capital letter of a proper noun or acronym, e.g. 'A' in Agra, 'R' in Raisin, 'R' in RIPv1; pushes toward data-format names like json and html.

L27n863.name: Piece before 'min'
L27n863.description: Negative on the piece just before 'min' in culminated, disseminating, determine and similar words; pushes toward 'min' spam.

L27n889.name: Stem before -ish
L27n889.description: Fires on the stem just before an 'ish' ending, e.g. 'extingu|ish', 'demol|ish', 'replen|ish'; pushes toward 'sh' tokens.

L27n412.name: Piece before -er ending
L27n412.description: Negative on the word piece before an agent '-er' or '-ers' ending, e.g. 'engr|aver', 'Fore|ster', 'gard|ener', 'retrie|vers'; pushes toward agent nouns like 'controller'.

L27n634.name: Saint abbreviation St
L27n634.description: Negative on 'St' or 'Saint' before a saint's name (St. Paul's, Saint Francis); pushes toward male first names like John, David and Michael.

L27n1838.name: Proper-name fragments, employee
L27n1838.description: Positive on the first subword piece of a capitalized place or proper name split into tokens (Man-ahawkin, Te-esside, Ne-oplatonic, Ban-ff, Car-thage). Pushes toward 'employee/employees'; strong steering spams 'Employee'.

L27n2624.name: Word-start fragments, constant
L27n2624.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into subword tokens, e.g. 'fl' in flammable/flaky, 'shr' in shrub, 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'ef' in indefinite. Pushes toward 'constant/constants'; strong steering spams 'constant'.

L27n3016.name: Split p/op fragments, push
L27n3016.description: Goes strongly negative on a split-word piece beginning with p or o, often after a hyphen: 'yp' in pypa, '-p' in roller-pushing, '-p' in self-published, 'op' in aeroplane. Pushes toward 'push/Push/pull'; strong steering spams 'push'.

L27n2830.name: Word-start m/um fragments, distance
L27n2830.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of words split into tokens, e.g. 'e' in Elaeis, 'em' in emulated, 'm' in masher, 'um' in Mpumalanga, 'inc' in incision. Pushes toward 'distance/Distance'; strong steering spams 'distance'.

L27n232.name: Street and downtown geography
L27n232.description: Positive across city, street and landmark descriptions, peaking on 'Avenue', 'Fifth Street', 'downtown', 'Park' and on numbers inside address or dimension text. Pushes toward 'city/cities'; strong steering spams 'city'.

L27n1817.name: Split fragments, cross-link
L27n1817.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces of split words in technical text: 'cross' in collagen cross-links, 'pl' in plink, '-L' in Lung, 'D' in DHA, 'ench' in enchilada. Pushes toward 'link/links'; strong steering spams 'Link'.

L27n2145.name: str/exp fragments, flag
L27n2145.description: Positive on the first piece of split words, mainly 'str' in straits, straddles, strung, and 'exp' in expatriate, expediency, plus 'rep' and 'reb'. Pushes toward 'flag/flags'; strong steering spams 'flag'.

L27n1453.name: cons/ins fragments, sign
L27n1453.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of cons- or ins- words: 'cons' in conscription, consistent, conserved; 'ins' in inscribed; 'trans' in neurotransmitters. Pushes toward 'sign/signs'; strong steering spams 'sign'.

L27n2675.name: Split-word fragments, art
L27n2675.description: Goes strongly negative on pieces of long or rare words: 'mp' in sympathetic, 'h' in Stonehenge, 'st' in stumbles, 'poly' in polygamy, 'in' in rhinoceros. Pushes toward 'art/Art'; strong steering spams 'Artart'.

L27n749.name: gl/Re fragments, field-names
L27n749.description: Positive on the first piece of split words, mainly 'gl' in glabrous, glazes, glottal and 'Re' in Rebellions, Recreational. Pushes toward code field names 'Data/User/Type/Name'; strong steering sometimes spams 'Name', otherwise ordinary text.

L27n671.name: Tech acronyms, URL
L27n671.description: Positive on software and web acronyms (SEO, PHP, SQL, VPN, GPU, Google) and on 'helpful' after 'You are a' in chat system prompts. Pushes toward 'URL/JSON/API/URI'; strong steering spams 'URL'.

L27n266.name: Odd fragments, quote tags
L27n266.description: Goes strongly negative on scattered word fragments and punctuation: 'def' in defocused, 'Elf' in Johan Elf, 'd' in douches, '(' before a figure reference, '<' and '>' tags. Pushes toward two-letter capitals 'FC/CB/MF'; strong steering spams 'CBBC' or 'FC' strings.

L27n833.name: Pre-verb token, drink
L27n833.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an expected action verb in how-to and symptom text: 'to' in ask you to lie, cause them to swell, 'after' in after urinating, 'brushing', 'washing'. Pushes toward 'drink/drinking/beverage'; strong steering spams 'drink'.

L27n2778.name: sh fragments, sudo ASS
L27n2778.description: Positive on word-start 'sh' pieces (shaver, shroud, shoveling, shakshuka, shored) and on 'ASS' in NOPASSWD sudoers lines. Pushes toward 'Linux/Unix/printf'; strong steering spams 'Linux'.

L27n2798.name: pr word-start fragments, variables
L27n2798.description: Positive on the first piece of split names and words: 'pr' in prairies, prune, Prius, Priscus; 'Pe' in Peisistratus; 'Bh' in Bhagabhadra; 'hon' in honours. Pushes toward 'variable/variables'; strong steering spams 'variables'.

L27n1344.name: M-initial word starts, map
L27n1344.description: Goes strongly negative on capital or lowercase 'M/m' starting a word split into tokens (Mackerel, Mussels, Mining, Mamba, Mounds), with weaker hits on 'treasure' and 'sweet'. Pushes toward 'map/maps'; strong steering spams 'map'.

L27n2188.name: re- prefix fragments, replace
L27n2188.description: Positive on the 're' or 'Re' prefix piece of split words (reusable, reseeded, reproductive, non-renewable), with weaker hits on 'Rep', 'Rip', 'ex', 'un'. Pushes toward 'replace/replacement'; strong steering spams 'replace'.

L27n1790.name: ent/benef fragments, request
L27n1790.description: Positive on the first piece of split verbs and nouns: 'ent' in entice, entrees, entitles; 'benef' in beneficiary; 'reaff' in reaffirmation; 'Zam' in Zambezi. Pushes toward 'request/requests/ask'; strong steering spams 'request'.

L27n2986.name: Two-letter word starts, behavior
L27n2986.description: Positive on the short first piece of split words: 'sm' in smokers, 'Av' in Avian, 'Dev' in Devonta, 'ab' in abridged, 'Em' in emotional, 'av' in avionics. Pushes toward 'behavior/behaviour'; strong steering spams 'Behavior'.

L27n1532.name: trans/dis/col starts, location
L27n1532.description: Positive on the first piece of split words: 'trans' in transcribed, transmitted, transposition; 'dis' in dissecting, disintegrates; 'col' in collocates; 'repl' in replanted. Pushes toward 'location/locations'; strong steering spams 'location'.

L27n1194.name: Split 'un' prefix
L27n1194.description: The 'un' piece of a word split into tokens (un|banked, un|regulated, un|viable), and dashes before an appositive. Pushes toward 'on'/'ons' word endings.

L27n406.name: Mid-word fragment, plural push
L27n406.description: The first piece of a word split mid-word, often a verb stem before its ending (j|uts, rel|ieves, d|ries, gl|azes). Pushes toward plural nouns like 'Games' and 'Files'.

L27n260.name: Word-start fragment, 'Google'
L27n260.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized or rare word split into tokens (wh|etstone, Att|ired, Ch|aco, Gh|af). Pushes toward 'Google'.

L27n2068.name: Proper-noun start fragment
L27n2068.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split proper noun or food word (And|alusia, Ar|agon, Có|rdoba, Qu|inoa). Pushes toward 'representation'.

L27n2296.name: Verb onset 'st' fragment
L27n2296.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a word split mid-word, most often 'st' or 'w' in verbs (st|rolled, st|umbles, w|aded) and name pieces (Có|rdoba). Pushes toward 'bound'.

L27n2977.name: Rare-word fragment, 'secret'
L27n2977.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a rare or name word (Bam|ako, squ|andered, Gen|ocide, Tong|a). Pushes toward 'secret' and 'hidden'.

L27n2365.name: Hyphen compound '-p'
L27n2365.description: Fires on the piece right after a hyphen in compounds, mostly '-p' (twisted-p|air, shaded-p|ole, -p|atching). Pushes toward 'pair'.

L27n2191.name: Medical word fragment, 'suggest'
L27n2191.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split word (sc|oliosis, pl|ating, medic|ated, t|innitus). Pushes toward 'suggest' and 'recommend'.

L27n50.name: Capital-letter name start
L27n50.description: Fires on a capitalized word start after a hyphen or slash, or at a list-item name (-S|ponsored, C|atan, S|olanum, H|iroshima). Pushes toward word tails like '-raries' and '-ileges'.

L27n865.name: Opening quote mark
L27n865.description: Goes negative on an opening quotation mark (“ or ‘), or on a hyphen piece, right before a quoted term or title. Pushes toward closing quote and apostrophe characters.

L27n1192.name: Word-start 'mol'/'Cl' fragment
L27n1192.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split word (mol|ars, mol|ting, Cl|imb, Cl|ifton, hyp|odermis). Pushes toward 'limit' and 'lim'.

L27n2037.name: Single 'c' word start
L27n2037.description: Fires on a lone 'c' that opens a word split off a longer term (c|actus, c|AMP, c|asks, c|abling, c|elsius). Pushes toward 'core'.

L27n2331.name: Mid-word fragment, '-ent' push
L27n2331.description: Fires on a word-internal fragment that a suffix completes (Sacr|ament, sed|entary, sed|iments, ind|ented). Pushes toward 'ent' endings.

L27n930.name: Fragment before '-ad'
L27n930.description: Goes negative on the stem piece just before an '-ad' ending (kne|ading, Crus|ade, igr|ade, ball|ads, cit|adel). Pushes toward 'ad' tokens.

L27n1492.name: Word-start 'com'/'suff' fragment
L27n1492.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word, often a prefix-like piece (com|ical, suff|ragette, contr|arious, Ab|ilene). Pushes toward 'comparison' and 'compare'.

L27n2608.name: Name-start fragment, 'Dem'
L27n2608.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word (Hor|owitz, Barack, Div|estment, Op|elika, j|amb). Pushes toward 'Dem' and 'dem'.

L27n1708.name: Name-start fragment, 'generate'
L27n1708.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word (Ep|iphanes, P|isa, me|galomaniac, se|ceded, h|ickories). Pushes toward 'generate' and 'generation'.

L27n2147.name: Word-tail fragment, 'ter'
L27n2147.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment that starts a word continued after it (shr|ub, rit|ters, cro|aking, dr|achmas, -t|ail). Pushes toward 'terminal' and 'ter'.

L27n1051.name: Name start, hyphen-capital push
L27n1051.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name in lists (Phar|rell, Mar|bella, Dr|., Daw|, Ken|). Pushes toward hyphen-plus-capital-letter tokens like '-D' and '-P'.

L27n2724.name: Capital 'D' fragment
L27n2724.description: Goes negative on a capital 'D' that starts a split word (D|HA, D|izziness, D|ried, D|angers, D|rought). Pushes toward 'imply' and 'implies'.

L27n350.name: Mid-word fragment, writes -ly
L27n350.description: Second or later piece of a rare or split word, mostly names and Latin or Sanskrit terms ('ht' in Ikhtiyar, 'oph' in sarcophagi, 'ś' in sutra); pushes toward 'ly' and 'cy' tokens.

L27n2715.name: Science-name piece, writes stat
L27n2715.description: Piece inside long science or agency names before 'statistics' ('ost' in biostatistics, 'Health' before Statistics, 'Agricultural' before Statistical); pushes toward 'stat' and 'statistics'.

L27n2040.name: Split-word piece, writes sym
L27n2040.description: Second piece of a split or hyphenated word, often right after a hyphen (quasi-s|culptural, anti-s|hear, abs|cess, Val|gus); pushes toward 'sym' tokens.

L27n1917.name: Mid-word fragment, writes gap
L27n1917.description: Second piece of multi-token words, e.g. 'deg' in degenerate and degeneration, 'fr' in franchised, 'if' in kiwifruit; pushes toward 'gap' and 'holes'.

L27n1527.name: Stem before -row
L27n1527.description: Word-middle piece right before a 'row' or 'rows' ending (nar|rows, bur|rows, corn|rows, eb|row), plus 'elect' in electrons; pushes toward 'row'.

L27n160.name: Modal/infinitive, writes suffixes
L27n160.description: Diffuse: modal verbs ('should', 'must', 'can', 'not') and 'to' before a bare verb, plus sentence-initial 'A'; pushes toward suffix pieces like 'ial', 'ity', 'ation'.

L27n2818.name: Word-start 'se' piece
L27n2818.description: Word-initial 's' or 'se' piece split off from its word (s|cones, Se|awater, s|ycamore, se|borrhea); pushes toward 'seed' and 'ball'.

L27n1719.name: Mid-word fragment, writes sequence
L27n1719.description: Word-middle piece of split words (sap|odilla, sap|wood, Mes|ozoic, gr|ubs); pushes toward 'sequence' and 'seq'.

L27n423.name: Name fragment, writes H
L27n423.description: Mid-word piece of names and rare terms (Hos|ack, dis|ulf|ide, arr|hythmias, Açva|ghosha); pushes toward capital-H tokens like 'HC', 'HA' and 'ho'.

L27n386.name: Digits and lists, diffuse
L27n386.description: Diffuse: digits inside long numbers and formulas (the '2' in '2n', the '0' in long decimals) and items in long lists; pushes toward code-like ':' and quote-tuple tokens.

L27n1788.name: Name fragment, writes page
L27n1788.description: Word-start piece of names and words (Pag|len, Ker|et, sou|ling, Sp|elling, Cop|eland); pushes toward 'page' and 'pages'.

L27n2030.name: Hyphenated s, writes save
L27n2030.description: A lone 's' or 'S' piece after a hyphen or at a split word start (ex-S|ervicemen, self-s|acrifice, Seven S|ages); pushes toward 'save' and 'saving'.

L27n823.name: Word-start piece, writes int
L27n823.description: First piece of a word split across tokens (spl|ints, squ|ishy, verm|ilion, subst|ations); pushes toward 'int' tokens.

L27n569.name: Word-start p, closing punctuation
L27n569.description: Word-start 'p', 'P' or 'Th' piece of a split word (per|inatal, P|erna, p|iano, Th|espians); pushes toward closing quote-paren-period punctuation.

L27n1322.name: r fragment, writes hot
L27n1322.description: A lone 'r' or 're' piece inside split words (legume-r|hizobium, sebor|r|hea, igr in Tigris, r|ambutan); pushes toward 'hot' and 'heat'.

L27n330.name: Name fragment, writes L
L27n330.description: Mid-word piece of names and words (Kare|lian, Roosevel|ts, de Gaul|le, tocopher|ol); pushes toward capital-L tokens like 'Li' and 'LI'.

L27n1935.name: Stem before -ice
L27n1935.description: Stem right before an 'ic' or 'ice' ending split off as its own token (ju|ice, lic|orice, extr|icably, ellipt|ic, apr|icots, hydro|ponic); pushes toward 'ice' and 'ic'.

L27n275.name: Word fragment, writes Japan
L27n275.description: Word-internal piece of multi-token words (inhib|itory, cultiv|ars, Hoj|ib|lanca, Hunga Ha'|apai); pushes toward 'Japan' and 'Japanese'.

L27n824.name: Name fragment, writes station
L27n824.description: Word-internal piece of names and terms (Tar|qu|inius, Bre|asted, sarc|oph|agi, C|en|ozoic); pushes toward 'station' tokens.

L27n2860.name: pr word-start, writes principle
L27n2860.description: Word-start 'pr' or 'Pr' piece (pr|actices, Pr|ismic, pr|ays, Pr|akasa); pushes toward 'principle' and 'principal'.

L27n580.name: Tech fragments → file-dots
L27n580.description: Fires on a mid-name piece in web and tech text, e.g. 'M' before '-file', 'Vue', 'React', '.gov', 'Write' in 'Write About'; pushes toward file-extension dot tokens like '.h', '.c', '.x'.

L27n958.name: Word stem → semicolon
L27n958.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into tokens, e.g. 'shr' in shrubbery, 'pal' in palamedes, 'tw' in twitches, 'Ar' in Arbequina; pushes toward ';' and ');' code-ending tokens.

L27n1789.name: Word start → 'gas'
L27n1789.description: Fires on a word-start fragment whose word continues in the next token, e.g. 'gan' in gantry, 'Brid' in Bridgeton, 'kil' in kilogram, 'ys' in Gettysburg; pushes toward 'gas' tokens.

L27n1847.name: Name fragments → precision
L27n1847.description: Fires on a mid-name piece of a split proper noun, e.g. 'Clem' in Clemenceau, 'Ari' in Ariane, 'Kh' in Khisa, 'elt' in Alka-Seltzer; pushes toward 'precision' and 'exact' tokens.

L27n935.name: 'st' onset → negative
L27n935.description: Fires on the 'st' that starts a word split into tokens, e.g. stews, stuffs, stings, stromal, stanzas; pushes toward 'neg' and 'negative' tokens.

L27n2952.name: Harm context → loss
L27n2952.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'loss' or 'losses' in texts about harm, death or casualties, e.g. 'pregnancy' in 'reported pregnancy losses', 'Bee' in the honeybee colony loss report; pushes toward 'loss' tokens.

L27n2478.name: Prefix fragment → member
L27n2478.description: Fires on a word-start fragment that opens a longer verb or noun, mostly 'rem' (removes, removed) and 'mes' (mesas, mesosphere), plus '-m' and 'sed'; pushes toward 'member' tokens.

L27n1689.name: Ownership context → property
L27n1689.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'property', in texts about ownership, slavery or privatization, e.g. 'as' in 'treated as slaves', 'private', 'national industries'; pushes toward 'property' tokens.

L27n2866.name: Short onset → screen
L27n2866.description: Fires on a 1–2 letter onset that starts a word split into tokens, mostly 'Q' (QbD, Qatari, Qulu) and 'sm', 'sc', 'sl' (smokes, smoldering, semi-); pushes toward 'screen' tokens.

L27n292.name: Open bracket → closer
L27n292.description: Fires on an opening '(' that starts an acronym or aside, e.g. '(CARD)', '(PDD-NOS)', '(Elaeis', and on hyphen-joined compound starts like '-limited'; pushes toward ')' and ']' to close.

L27n2233.name: Phrase start → edge
L27n2233.description: Fires on word-start fragments like 'Ste', 'cu', 'stret', and on 'Cutting' before a likely 'edge' (cutting edge); pushes toward 'edge' tokens.

L27n1525.name: Mid-word fragment → ge
L27n1525.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split rare word, e.g. 'ann' in crannog, 'ser' in serfdom, 'quar' in quarries, 'gu' in guineensis, 'diver' in diverge; pushes toward 'ge' and 'geo' tokens.

L27n1707.name: Latin fragment → access
L27n1707.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a long technical or Latin word, e.g. 'ic' in bactericidal, 'od' in Rhododendron, 'ace' in Pteridaceae, 'rh' in rhizomes; pushes toward 'access' tokens.

L27n310.name: Rare-name fragment → d
L27n310.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of rare names and loanwords, e.g. 'ṛ' in Hṛdaya, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Cyc' in Cycadales; pushes toward tokens starting with 'd'.

L27n2448.name: Word fragment → join
L27n2448.description: Fires on a word piece that begins a longer term, e.g. '-br' in blood-brain, 'av' in Pirqe avot, 'erv' in pervasive, 'ptic' in septic, and 'sign' before 'up'; pushes toward 'join' tokens.

L27n631.name: Name initial → brace
L27n631.description: Fires on the first letter or short start token of a capitalized name or reference, e.g. 'P' in Potters Bar, 'H' in Hertfordshire, 'p' in pails, 'sc' in scallions; pushes toward '{' braces.

L27n445.name: 'an' before adjective
L27n445.description: Fires on a word in a chat answer that comes right before an adjective or noun phrase, e.g. 'an' in 'an important role', 'an essential part', or 'employs' and 'significant'; pushes toward quote-comma tokens.

L27n571.name: German name fragments
L27n571.description: Fires on pieces of German-origin names and words split into tokens, e.g. 'ots' in Potsdam, 'Ost' in Ostereierbaum, 'Biedermann', 'ues' in Brühoff; pushes toward 'German', 'von' and 'Sch' tokens.

L27n1963.name: Name particle → output
L27n1963.description: Fires on the piece of a personal name that continues it, e.g. 'ben' in 'Eleazar ben Simon', 'Ban' in Ban Ki-moon, 'L' in Lauterpacht, 'Hale' in Halevy; pushes toward 'output' tokens.

L27n551.name: Modifier before head noun
L27n551.description: Fires on the modifier of a two-word technical or proper phrase, just before its head noun, e.g. 'Regional' before 'Cooperation', 'magnetic' before 'field', 'Monetary' before 'Fund', 'time' before 'complexity'; pushes toward generic nouns like 'feature' and 'parameter'.

L27n1457.name: Medical word-stem fragments
L27n1457.description: Fires (negative) on a mid-word piece of a long scientific or medical term, e.g. 'cre' in crevasse, 'symb' in symbiosis, 'rh' in cirrhosis, 'ar' in arthritis. Negative push writes 'os' tokens (osteo, -osis), so steered text spams 'OS'.

L27n622.name: Name fragments, Â writer
L27n622.description: Fires on the piece of a capitalized name split across tokens, e.g. 'k' in Dolaucothi, 'Mal' in Malawi, 'L' in Lohmann, 'ort' in Bortnyik. Pushes toward mojibake 'Â'/'â' tokens, so steered text spams 'Â'.

L27n185.name: Stray fragments, consonant writer
L27n185.description: Fires on stray word fragments in mixed-language text and split words, e.g. Cyrillic 'и' in Сибирь, 'pa' in palettes, 'a' in aches, 'onta' in Devonta. Pushes toward single consonant tokens (t, s, d, c, m, n), so steered text degenerates into strings like 'tmnmnm'.

L27n1211.name: Hyphen-compound joins
L27n1211.description: Fires on the word before a hyphen and on the hyphen-plus-letter piece that joins a compound modifier, e.g. 'tight' and '-k' in tight-knit, 'low' in low-income, 'well' in well-regarded. Pushes toward hyphen-plus-letter tokens (-c, -f, -p), so steered text spams 'Elena-felt-cold-cold'.

L27n1743.name: Noun fragments, writes 'hour'
L27n1743.description: Fires on a middle piece of a noun split into tokens, e.g. 'ame' in chameleons, 'aw' in hawthorn, 'Mer' in Merino, 'is' in Crisps. Pushes toward 'hour(s)' and 'Night', so steered text stutters 'Night hours hour hour'.

L27n174.name: Technical word middles
L27n174.description: Fires (negative) on a middle piece of a long technical word, e.g. 'ni' in Wozniak, 'ose' in femtosecond, 'ly' in aminoglycoside, 'vir' in antiretrovirals. Negative push writes 'c' tokens (kc, coc, cc), so steered text spams 'Coco cecchc'.

L27n2459.name: Word fragments, writes 'parent'
L27n2459.description: Fires (negative) on a word piece or hyphen-part inside a longer term, e.g. 'dew' in dewormed, '-br' in blood-brain, 'germ' in germplasm, 'Rep' in Reproductive. Negative push writes 'parent/parents', so steered text spams 'Parent'.

L27n2120.name: Prefix-like starts, writes 'fix'
L27n2120.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that begins with a prefix-like fragment, e.g. 'ref' in refueling, 'inf' in infirm, 'def' in Indefinite, 'unf' in unfunded. Pushes toward 'fix/fixed' tokens, so steered text spams 'Fix fix fix'.

L27n2415.name: Names before 'organization'
L27n2415.description: Fires on the first word of a technical or institutional name, e.g. 'Meteor' in World Meteorological Organization, 'Computer' in Computer Architecture, 'Oxidation' in Oxidation States. Pushes toward 'organization/organ' next, so steered text spams 'Organ organization'.

L27n1922.name: Phrase-middle pieces, writes 'character'
L27n1922.description: Fires on the mid-phrase token of fixed terms and split words, e.g. 'in' in stay in shape, 'otherwise' in not otherwise specified, 'uter' in intrauterine, 'ider' in epidermis. Pushes toward 'character/characteristic', so steered text stutters 'Character character'.

L27n2043.name: Modifier before 'potential'
L27n2043.description: Fires on the adjective right before a broad noun, e.g. 'academic' in academic performance, 'human' in human rights, 'true' in true identity, 'genetic' in genetic makeup. Pushes toward 'potential', so steered text spams 'potential potential'.

L27n1019.name: Opening parenthesis after terms
L27n1019.description: Fires on an opening '(' that starts a parenthetical right after a name or term, e.g. 'Prophet (', 'IGF-1 (', '(ASD)', '(PDD-NOS)', '(60.1 °F)'. Pushes toward single consonant letters (b, d, p, c, t), so steered text spams 'dpdpdp'.

L27n1613.name: Genetic-element word starts
L27n1613.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a technical term, mostly genetics, e.g. 'retro' in retroviruses, 'DNA' in DNA sequences, 'fuse' in fusion, 'elect' in electrophoresis. Negative push writes 'element/elements', so steered text spams 'Element elements'.

L27n2217.name: Latin-name fragments, writes 'water'
L27n2217.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment in Latin species names or foreign names, e.g. 'ht' in Ikhtiyar, 'put' in Pseudomonas putida, 'apt' in Diaptomus, 'ell' in Selaginellaceae. Pushes toward 'water' tokens, so steered text spams 'Waterwater'.

L27n1459.name: Prefix starts, writes '-based'
L27n1459.description: Fires on a prefix-like piece that starts a word or hyphen compound, e.g. 're' in reorganized and restructure, 'co' in co-operative, 'mis' in misshapen, 'self' in self-organise. Pushes toward hyphen suffixes '-based', '-like', '-style', so steered text spams '-like-like'.

L27n1282.name: 'in' in fixed phrases
L27n1282.description: Fires (negative) on the 'in' or 'a' in fixed prepositional phrases, e.g. 'in' in 'health in mind', 'in place', 'in full swing', 'with a view'. Negative push writes 'view/views' tokens, so steered text spams 'view view'.

L27n1158.name: Split word-starts, writes 'create'
L27n1158.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often 'sc' (scoliosis, Scissorhands, scraping), 'conc' (concordance), 'ac' (across), and on 'Digital' in Adobe Digital Editions. Pushes toward 'create/creation' tokens, so steered text spams 'Create creation'.

L27n1985.name: Split word pieces, 'match'
L27n1985.description: Fires (negative) on a second piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'And' in Andalusia, 'cro' in crocodiles, 'mel' in melons, '/M' in INDEX/MATCH, '-N' in KwaZulu-Natal. Negative push writes 'match/matches', so steered text spams 'Match match'.

L27n1381.name: Verb-stem starts, writes reflexives
L27n1381.description: Fires (negative) on the first piece of a split verb or past-tense stem, e.g. 'spr' in sprouted and sprang, 'sh' in shut down, 'dec' in decimated, 'def' in defied. Negative push writes reflexive pronouns 'herself/himself/myself', so steered text spams 'herself herself'.

L27n546.name: Word-onset fragments, writes 'systems'
L27n546.description: Fires on the first consonant-cluster piece of a split word, mostly 'st' (staves, stolons, stews), 'sl' (slippers), 'pl' (plagues), 'Di' (Diets). Pushes toward plural structure nouns 'systems/arrays/lists', so steered text spams 'systems systems'.

L27n2025.name: Mid-word fragments, clean
L27n2025.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into subword tokens, strongest on '-st' in non-stick and pre-stressed, and on mid-word 'ro', 'co', 'fe' (neuroma, cochlea, roots). Pushes toward 'clean' tokens; steered, it spams 'Clean'.

L27n3050.name: Single-letter c/g word starts
L27n3050.description: Fires on a lone 'c', 'g' or 'Sc' that begins a word piece after a hyphen or split, e.g. -candle, -celled, -coding, -cage, 'G' in antibody G. Pushes toward 'miss/mission' tokens; steered, it spams 'Mis'.

L27n2796.name: Word-initial g/sh/be pieces
L27n2796.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split word, mostly 'g' (sweetgums, grafted, gingersnap), 'be' (beaded), 'sh' (shampoos), 'ros' (chondrosarcoma). Pushes toward 'remove/removal' tokens; steered, it spams 'Remove'.

L27n1475.name: Radi/thr/dec word fragments
L27n1475.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split into pieces, strongest on 'radi' (radiologists, radiocarbon), 'ort' in Bortnyik, 'thr' (thrusters), 'dec' (decarbonising), 'ste' (steak). Pushes toward 'temperature/thermal' tokens; steered, it spams 'Temperature'.

L27n2484.name: re-/o- word fragments
L27n2484.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, mostly 're' (reclamation, reintegration, reigned), 'sur' (surges), 'o' (oysters), 'Dor' (Dorset), 'Ch' (Chhattisgarh). Pushes toward 'claim/assert' tokens; steered, it spams 'claim'.

L27n1875.name: Sp/squ/ph word starts
L27n1875.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word, mostly 'Sp' (Spending), 'squ' (squirts), 'ph' (phagocytes), 'sp' (cerebrospinal), 'Forum'. Pushes toward 'Na/sodium' tokens; steered, it spams 'Na'.

L27n247.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L27n247.description: Fires on 'to' right before a bare verb: infinitive 'to' ('to be read', 'to sign up', 'TAKE YOUR TIME TO EAT') and the 'to' in 'easy-to-follow' instruction phrases. Pushes toward action verbs like determine, create, calculate; steered, it spams verbs like 'solve' and 'create'.

L27n887.name: Mid-word pieces, get
L27n887.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'ile' (cantilevered), 'Zam' (Zambezi), '-car' (low-carbon), 'VE' (VE Day), 'Not' (You May Not Know). Pushes toward 'get' tokens; steered, it spams 'Get'.

L27n199.name: Words inside proper names
L27n199.description: Fires on a word inside a proper name or title, e.g. 'Knight' (Knight of the Garter), 'Cape' (Cape Mount), 'Kuala' (Kuala Lumpur), 'Is' (How Old Is My Kitten), 'Queen', 'Copyright'. Pushes toward code identifiers 'Val/Var/Sec'; steered, it spams 'Val'.

L27n1982.name: Short word-start pieces, LaTeX
L27n1982.description: Fires on short or capital word-start pieces inside names and words, e.g. 'St' (Sticherus, stakeholder), 'Per' (Perak), 'w' (waddling), 'Re', 'Pro', 'Part'. Pushes toward the LaTeX backslash token; steered, it spams backslashes and newlines.

L27n1060.name: Split-word pieces, max
L27n1060.description: Fires on a split-word piece, e.g. 'em' (light-emitting), 'Wi' (Wi-Fi), 'cl' (clenching), 'sw' (swimmers), 'Rem' (Reminiscent), '/M' (pMIC). Pushes toward 'max' tokens; steered, it spams 'Max'.

L27n1312.name: Math and STEM fragments
L27n1312.description: Fires on 'math' in STEM lists and fragments like '-m' (non-math), 'polym' (polymath), 'and' in 'Engineering and Math', 'M' (M.P.H.). Pushes toward 'math' tokens; steered, it spams 'Math'.

L27n22.name: Closing quote/bracket marks
L27n22.description: Fires on closing punctuation that ends a quote or bracket: ')', '”', '.”', ']', '*', and ').' after a parenthesis. Diffuse across list-like text. Pushes toward single capital letters (O, H, U, E, G); steered, it spams random capitals.

L27n2803.name: Inner pieces of names
L27n2803.description: Fires on an inner piece of a person or place name, e.g. 'San' (San Luis Obispo, San Simeon), 'iod' (Heliodorus), 'Ish' (Ishiguro), 'enc' (enclosures), 'U' (U.K.), 'Fr' (Fr.). Pushes toward nationality and country words (Australian, Philippine, nil); steered, it spams 'Australian'.

L27n1735.name: Mid-word 'ent' and 'title'
L27n1735.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, e.g. 'ent' (entitles, entice), 'conc' (concisely), '-t' (non-touristy), '-h' (self-harm), 'ER' (FERPA). Pushes toward 'title' tokens; steered, it spams 'Title'.

L27n1433.name: Hard G word starts
L27n1433.description: Fires on a 'g' or 'G' that starts a word or name piece, e.g. 'G' (Goma, Gatsby, Glooskap), 'g' (grieved, gloomy), '-g' (God-given), '-G' (Governor). Pushes toward 'improve/improvement' tokens; steered, it spams 'Improved'.

L27n1555.name: Shrub, ranch, range words
L27n1555.description: Fires on the opening piece of plant, land or grazing words, mainly 'shr' (shrubs, shrubbery), 'r' (ranch, rangers, rams), 'grazing'. Pushes toward 'range' tokens; steered, it spams 'Range'.

L27n2127.name: Integration word pieces
L27n2127.description: Fires on word pieces inside 'integration' and its viral and biological relatives, mainly 'oint' (osseointegration), 'iral' and 'v' (retroviral), 'ogenous' (endogenous), 'Int'. Pushes toward 'integrat-' tokens; steered, it spams 'Integration'.

L27n690.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n690.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that starts with a consonant cluster, mainly 'str' (straddles, straits), 'sc' (scatters), 'sh' (shunt), 'bl' (blurring), 'fl' (flank), 'squ'. Pushes toward empty bracket pairs like '[]', '()' and '{}'; steered, it spams '[]'.

L27n2751.name: Split-word pieces, weight
L27n2751.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a split word, e.g. 'bul' (bulges), 'aw' (gigawatts), 'ow' (bioweapons), 'ew' (lukewarm), 'pl' (plating), 'rol' (trolleys). Pushes toward 'weight' tokens; steered, it spams 'Weight'.

L27n2937.name: Word fragments; writes 'activity'
L27n2937.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'aqu' in aquaculture, 'thr' in throng, 'accom', 'os' in osseointegrating. Pushes the model toward 'activity' (steering spams 'Activity').

L27n1449.name: Public-place nouns; writes 'square'
L27n1449.description: Goes strongly negative on the head noun of a civic or public-space phrase: 'public' (forum, eye), 'market' (place), 'Main' (Street), 'town' (fortifications), 'Memorial' (Park). Pushing it negative steers toward 'square'.

L27n461.name: Name start; writes 'shows'
L27n461.description: Fires on the first token of a person's name or proper-noun subject (Jean, Chris, Barbara, William, Dr, Claude, Robert), mostly where a verb should come next. Pushes the model toward present-tense verbs after a subject: 'shows', 'leads', 'raises', 'creates'.

L27n770.name: Subword starts; writes '%'
L27n770.description: Fires on the first fragment of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'ant' (antibiotics, antiretrovirals), 'cent' (centimetres, centred), 'Th' or 'Port' in place names. Pushes the model toward '%' (steering spams '%').

L27n3057.name: Word fragments; writes 'bacteria'
L27n3057.description: Goes strongly negative on a short fragment inside a word or name, e.g. 'er' in Xerxes, 'lo' in locket and loaves, 'um' in Mpumalanga, 'om' in Chambom. Pushing it negative steers toward 'bacteria' and infection terms.

L27n1859.name: Name-start fragments; writes 'status'
L27n1859.description: Fires on the first piece of a split capitalized name or Latin genus word, e.g. 'Att' in Attica, 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'cr' in crannogs, 'Hur' in Huron. Pushes the model toward 'status' (steering spams 'status').

L27n1214.name: Pre-'color' slot; writes 'color'
L27n1214.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an expected 'color' or 'colour': 'of' in people of color, 'food' in food coloring, 'Ocean' in Ocean Color Imager, 'Hair'. Pushing it negative steers toward 'color'.

L27n307.name: Function word; writes 'users'
L27n307.description: Goes strongly negative on function words or word pieces right before a verb or noun head, e.g. 'to' in allowed to drain or cool, 'of' in practice of being, 'the' in the brain. Diffuse. Pushing it negative steers toward 'users', 'players', 'customers'.

L27n489.name: Percent digits; writes backslash
L27n489.description: Goes strongly negative on the digit before a '%' (the 0 in 70%, the 5 in 8.25%, the 9 in 99%) and on the first word of multi-word names (Passover, Object Management Group, Planned Behavior). Pushing it negative steers toward backslash and backtick tokens.

L27n1213.name: Word fragments; writes 'ar'
L27n1213.description: Fires on a word-piece inside a split word, e.g. 'ro' in bullfrogs, 'she' in shears, 'Rams' in Ramsar, 'os' in osteosarcoma, 'ju' in juice. Pushes the model toward 'ar' (steering spams 'ar').

L27n2905.name: Word-start 'rem'; writes 'planet'
L27n2905.description: Goes strongly negative on word-start pieces such as 'rem' in remaking, removes, remembrance, plus 'Vid' (Vidisha), 'Hou' (Houdon), 'm' (treadmills). Pushing it negative steers toward 'planet' and 'orbit'.

L27n1870.name: Word-start 'm'; writes 'material'
L27n1870.description: Fires on a lone 'm' (or 'mim', 'metam') that opens a split word: mowers, mugs, mucus, mists, masticatory, mofait. Pushes the model toward 'material(s)' (steering spams 'Material').

L27n2458.name: 'St' word-starts; writes 'India'
L27n2458.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'St' or 'st' split off from a longer word: Streak, stearic, stinkbug, stings, Stamps. Pushing it negative steers toward 'India' and 'Indian'.

L27n1091.name: Word fragments; writes 'o'
L27n1091.description: Fires on word-internal fragments of technical or rare words, e.g. 'cre' (crevice), 'rhe' (rheology), 'pneum', 'gor' (Novgorod), 'my' (myotoxic), 'ple' (pleural). Pushes the model toward 'o' pieces (steering spams 'Oo').

L27n1070.name: Compound modifier; writes 'select'
L27n1070.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word technical term, before its head noun: 'genetically' (deficient), 'genomic' (sequencing), 'facilitated' (diffusion), 'tummy' (time). Pushes the model toward 'select' and 'selection' (steering spams 'Select').

L27n944.name: Word fragments; writes 'magic'
L27n944.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'Bre' (Breasted, Red-breasted), 'be' (wildebeest), 'agn' (Armagnac), 'pig' (pigweeds). Pushes the model toward 'magic' (steering spams 'Magic').

L27n1700.name: Diffuse; writes 'condition'
L27n1700.description: Weak and diffuse. Goes strongly negative on determiners, prepositions or name pieces right before a noun phrase: 'la' (de la Cerda), 'the', 'on' (on the volcano), '-A' (Jean-Antoine). Pushing it negative steers toward 'condition(s)'.

L27n1666.name: 'ch' word-starts; writes 'var'
L27n1666.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'ch' (or 'c' or 'K') that opens a word or word piece: chops, chameleons, Chaco, chest, cabs, Karelian. Pushing it negative steers toward 'var'.

L27n2836.name: Word fragments; writes 'led'
L27n2836.description: Fires on word-internal fragments that split a longer verb or noun: 'bree' (breech), 'bus' (arbuscules), 'cul' (culminated), 'ho' (hoarding), 'exempl' (exemplified). Pushes the model toward 'led' (steering spams 'LED').

L27n1765.name: 'Happen' verbs; writes 'inf'
L27n1765.description: Goes strongly negative on verbs of occurring or going, e.g. 'happen' (every day), 'goes' (beyond), 'occur', 'go' (away), plus 'New' in place names and 'neu' in neuroma. Pushing it negative steers toward 'Inf' and 'exp' pieces.

L27n213.name: Mid-word fragment, underscore output
L27n213.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a name or word split into subword tokens (e.g. 'vl', 'Gl', 'uzz', 'fon' inside names); pushes toward '_' so the next piece joins an identifier or word.

L27n2293.name: Word-initial fragment, 'dark' output
L27n2293.description: Fires on the short opening piece of a word split into tokens (often a single letter or 'c', 'r', 'g', or 'carc' in 'carcasses'); pushes toward 'dark' and 'Dark' repetition.

L27n960.name: Capitalized/hyphen-prefix word start
L27n960.description: Fires on the opening fragment of a capitalized or hyphen-prefixed word split into tokens ('Har'penden, '-w'atched, 'Ch'ivalry, 'P'olar bear); pushes toward question openers 'Is', 'Can', 'Has', 'Are', 'Will'.

L27n2270.name: 'low' compounds, 'resource'
L27n2270.description: Fires on 'low' in hyphen compounds like 'low-resource', 'low-income', 'low-alcohol', and on other first pieces of split words (Gran-, hem-, Bo-); pushes toward 'resource(s)'.

L27n1524.name: Connective before place/nation
L27n1524.description: Fires on prepositions and commas right before a place, nation or list of countries ('as Burma', 'into Francia', 'upon Egyptian', 'through the town', 'Mennonite, Spanish') and on nationality adjectives; pushes toward 'countries', 'Canada', 'Italy', 'France', 'India'.

L27n1763.name: Word-initial 'm' in lists
L27n1763.description: Fires on a lone 'm' (or 'pr') that opens a split word in lists of animals, plants and things ('m'ites, 'm'ussels, 'm'ackerel, 'pr'airies, 'm'ists); pushes toward 'option(s)', which does not follow from the reading.

L27n2199.name: Battle/military name starts
L27n2199.description: Fires on the first piece of a military, battle or weapon name ('Bofors', 'Pickett's', 'regiments', 'Battalion', 'PzK') mostly in battle text; pushes toward 'war', 'battle', 'fight', 'fought'.

L27n1199.name: Biomedical term word-start
L27n1199.description: Fires on the opening piece of a biomedical or chemistry term split into tokens ('blo'od, 'Ven'om, 'Vit'amin, 'nit'rous, 'dial'ysis, 'oste'oporosis) and on 'the' before them; pushes toward process nouns 'creation', 'generation', 'addition', 'formation'.

L27n1558.name: Stem after hyphen/un-
L27n1558.description: Fires on the stem token right after a hyphen or 'un-' prefix in compounds ('hard-wiring', 'unpasteurized', 'uncovers', 'wild-catch', 'Self-cleaning'); pushes toward 'plus' and 'minus' sign words.

L27n395.name: Consonant-cluster word onset
L27n395.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens that opens with a consonant cluster ('gr'ubs, 'fl', 'b'oulders, 't'igers, 'st'ews, 'Gr'izzly); pushes toward semicolons and '!' or '?' punctuation.

L27n1376.name: Proper-name word onset
L27n1376.description: Fires on the opening piece of a proper name or rare word split into tokens ('Cost'olo, 'Mon'et, 'Mas'low, 'Zam'bezi, 'Aver'roes); pushes toward 'base', 'bases', 'basis'.

L27n1209.name: Modifier before 'change'
L27n1209.description: Fires on a noun modifier right before 'change(s)' in a compound ('clim'ate, 'sea'-level, 'diaper'-changing) and on compound openers like 'accom'panied; pushes toward 'change', 'changes', 'changing'.

L27n1353.name: Prefix-like onset, 'position'
L27n1353.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or prefix-like stem ('Comp'ounds, 'p'ines, 'presup'positions, 'pre'disposition, 'ap'entaenoic, 'bl'urring); pushes toward 'position(s)'.

L27n480.name: Determiner before a noun
L27n480.description: Fires on 'the', 'that' or 'his' right before the noun it introduces ('the fall', 'the Moon', 'that day', 'his death') and on 'desktop' in 'desktop or laptop'; pushes toward plural abstract nouns 'limits', 'benefits', 'costs'.

L27n430.name: Medical onset, LaTeX output
L27n430.description: Fires on the first piece of a medical or technical word split into tokens ('ple'ural, 'vert'ebrae, 'ar'thritic, 'Ven'oms, 'Ch'ronic, 'gl'ottal); pushes toward LaTeX backslash openers.

L27n2000.name: 'cr' word onset
L27n2000.description: Fires on the 'cr' (also 'car', 'po', 'spe') opening a word split into tokens: 'cr'umbly, 'cr'abs, 'cr'isps, 'cr'ickets, 'cr'ammed, 'put'rid; pushes toward 'noise', 'waste', 'garbage'.

L27n278.name: 'sh' onset in names
L27n278.description: Fires on 'sh' or 'Sh', or another short onset opening a word or name split into tokens ('sh'aking, 'Sh'ope, 'Mu'hammad, 'Cass'ia, 'Ik'eda); pushes toward middle-dot and angle-bracket symbols.

L27n2095.name: 'w'/'re'/'bre' onset
L27n2095.description: Fires on the consonant-cluster onset of a word split into tokens ('wre'cks, 'thro'ats, 'tre'ble, 'bre'eding, 'Re'nen's, 'Gre'te); pushes toward 'search' and 'Search'.

L27n1131.name: Single-letter onset, time-units
L27n1131.description: Fires on a one-letter or very short onset token opening a technical or name word split into tokens ('g'orges, 'og'lycoside, 'N'auvoo, 'n'avel, 'g'rafted); pushes toward time units 'years', 'days', 'hours', 'months'.

L27n869.name: Word before past participle
L27n869.description: Fires on 'had', 'have', 'has', 've' or 'reportedly' right before a past participle or past verb ('had risen', 'have fully formed', 'had plagued', 'had swollen', 'has also resulted'); pushes toward participles 'named', 'ordered', 'labeled', 'structured'.

L27n2294.name: Subword fragments, surgery/meat
L27n2294.description: Fires on the unfinished first piece of a word split into several tokens, such as 'pr' in prairie, 'bor' in seborrhea, 'de' in decontaminate, and 'bree' in breech, where the word is still incomplete. Pushes the model toward surgery, surgeon, bone and meat, and at high dose it loops on 'meat'.

L27n2903.name: Split-word fragments
L27n2903.description: Fires on a fragment inside a word split into odd subword tokens, such as the H in Hertfordshire, suff in suffocating, r in ripples, or -b in Battle; pushes toward 'delivery' and 'transport'.

L27n83.name: Structured text symbols, SQL
L27n83.description: Negative firing on symbols and word starts in structured text, such as SQL clauses, table pipes, the + in '(200+ words)', a newline before ORDER BY, and hydro in hydrology; pushes toward 'result' and 'private'. Pushed negative, it strips spaces from output.

L27n128.name: Mid-phrase tokens, closing parens
L27n128.description: Negative firing on assorted mid-phrase tokens in web and chat text, such as the colon after a path, 'by' after a title, 'and' in a list, or '(' before a parenthetical; pushes toward ')' tokens, and pushed negative it spams ')'.

L27n730.name: Nationality adjectives
L27n730.description: Fires on nationality or country adjectives just before their noun, such as 'British-born', 'Russian armies', 'Dutch army', 'Italian campaigns'; pushes toward '[' bracket tokens.

L27n1510.name: Mid-word rare-name fragments
L27n1510.description: Fires on a middle subword piece of a long or rare word split into several tokens, such as atem in Guatemalan, hyp in hypothyroidism, Ven in Veneto, or ph in phosphatases; pushes toward 'message' tokens.

L27n1512.name: Tense and compound-interest terms
L27n1512.description: Negative firing on a word in a tense or finance phrase that sets up a predictable next word, such as 'Present' or 'past' in tense lists and 'compounded' in 'compounded quarterly'; pushes toward 'continuous'.

L27n1001.name: Diffuse word-opening pieces
L27n1001.description: Weak, diffuse firing on the opening piece of a word or name that runs into more tokens, such as Ch in Chhattisgarh, sp in cerebrospinal, dev in deviate, or Indian in Indian Ocean; pushes toward 'sub' tokens.

L27n2926.name: Capital J, name openers
L27n2926.description: Fires on the first letter or opening piece of a name, mostly a capital J as in J.J. Thompson, Judd Apatow, or JSL, and also Inst in Instytut and Intr in Interstate; pushes toward 'symbol' tokens.

L27n225.name: Capital letter name starts
L27n225.description: Fires on a single capital letter or acronym start that begins a proper noun, such as M in Matisse, H in Hellenistic, E in EPA, D in D&D, or G in Glee; pushes toward uppercase letters.

L27n1894.name: Consonant-cluster word onsets
L27n1894.description: Fires on a word-opening consonant cluster split off as its own token, especially scr in scraping, cl in clumping or clippings, str in stricken, and cr in cradle; pushes toward 'begin' and 'beginning' tokens.

L27n2704.name: st word-onset fragments
L27n2704.description: Negative firing on a bare 'st' split off as the first token of a word, such as st|roma, st|irs, st|umbles, or st|anzas; pushes toward 'happen', 'happened' and 'occurs'.

L27n282.name: Food and farming phrases
L27n282.description: Fires inside food, farming and nutrition phrases, such as 'and' in 'Food and Drug', 'food' in 'food security', 'daily' in 'daily intake', or ony in Nyonya; pushes toward 'food', 'cooking' and 'culinary'.

L27n1265.name: Word-start fragments (sne)
L27n1265.description: Negative firing on the first piece of a word split across tokens, such as sne in sneezing, hon in honours, lo in locket, Ze in zebras, or Jan in Janus; pushes toward 'require' and 'requirement'.

L27n2452.name: Mid-word fragments (infinit)
L27n2452.description: Negative firing on a middle piece of a longer word split into tokens, such as infinit in infinitive, init in initives, oct in octopus, iterr in Mediterranean, or in in rhinotracheitis; pushes toward 'tree' and 'trees'.

L27n1066.name: Names' first pieces
L27n1066.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or long word split across tokens, such as Cart in Carte du Ciel, Vol in Volga, Kare in Karelian, Gra in Graubünden, or Stat in Statista; pushes toward 'model' tokens.

L27n1590.name: Bare word-onset letters
L27n1590.description: Fires on bare word-opening letters split off as their own token, especially j in juts, jicama, or jamb, sh in shatter or shored, and sc in scallions or screech; pushes toward newline and LaTeX-style escape tokens.

L27n2112.name: Technical compound first pieces
L27n2112.description: Fires on the first piece of a technical compound split across tokens, strongest on pharmac in pharmacodynamic and object in object-oriented; pushes toward 'dynamic' tokens.

L27n891.name: Chat user-turn role token
L27n891.description: Fires on the 'user' role word right after '<|im_start|>' that opens a user turn in chat prompts, and is near zero in web text; pushes toward ';' and '{' code punctuation.

L27n106.name: Identifier pieces and underscores
L27n106.description: Negative firing on pieces of identifiers and code-like names, such as my in my_field, _fl in _flaps, N in Slovin's formula, or the 2 in a SQL table name; pushes toward underscore-joined names like _time, _key and _length.

L27n1796.name: Consonant-cluster onsets (bre)
L27n1796.description: Fires on a word-opening consonant cluster split off as its own token, especially bre in breeder, gre in Greenshell, cre in crevice, and fre in freeware; pushes toward 'true' and 'True' tokens.

L27n961.name: Hyphen/split compound pieces
L27n961.description: Fires negative on the piece that opens or continues a hyphenated or split compound (self-improvement, vice-versa, tert-butyl, executive vice, mass Drug) before the word finishes; pushes output toward 'pro' prefix tokens.

L27n91.name: Place and proper-name endings
L27n91.description: Fires on the final piece of a proper place or country name (New Zealand, Hiroshima, Pittsburgh, Madagascar, Portugal); pushes output toward colour and shape words such as Blue, Triangle, Diamond and Silver.

L27n1627.name: Onset fragments 'sc'/'v'
L27n1627.description: Fires on the short first piece of a word split into tokens, mainly 'sc', 'v', 'V' and 'Ch' (scoliosis, scarring, Van Gogh, vermilion, Chhattisgarh); pushes output toward 'allow' and 'permitted'.

L27n1258.name: Rare-word start fragments
L27n1258.description: Fires on the first fragment of a long or rare word split into pieces (inter|red, fl|ares, Dur|ban, Mel|vin, ipp|uden, pre|exposure); pushes output toward 'high' and 'higher'.

L27n777.name: Medical/clinical word pieces
L27n777.description: Fires negative on mid-word pieces in health and clinical text (eff|usion, short|ness of breath, CINAHL, Fabry, Ep|ilepsy); pushes output toward 'patient', 'medical' and 'clinical'.

L27n359.name: IPA and transliteration characters
L27n359.description: Fires on IPA symbols and diacritic transliteration letters (ə, ˈ, ɪ, ḥ, Sanskrit and Arabic romanisation) and rare subword pieces in those scripts; pushes output toward word-initial 's' tokens such as sc, sp and sk.

L27n984.name: Word-start 'g', name-fragments
L27n984.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word, especially 'g' onsets (gums, Guelph, gingersnap, goslings) and Sanskrit or Hindu name pieces (Ram|ayana, Si, jan|eya); pushes output toward 'string' and 'strings'.

L27n477.name: Mid-word fragments of nouns
L27n477.description: Fires on the mid-word piece of a split noun (dwar|fs, phag|ocytes, Nil|otes, quas|ars, oas|ises); pushes output toward generic nouns 'elements', 'components' and 'tokens'.

L27n2958.name: Capitalized word-start fragments
L27n2958.description: Fires on the capitalized or all-caps piece that starts a split word (Gr|aceland, CRE|ATOR, RESP|ONDENCE, SM|ELL, SW|ALLOW); pushes output toward uppercase fragments UN, ON, AN and IN.

L27n924.name: Foreign name fragments
L27n924.description: Fires negative on mid-word pieces of foreign personal and place names (Ik|htiyar, Ram|ihantaniarivo, Zam|bezi, Rom|mel, Hos|ack); pushes output toward 'political', 'politics' and 'voters'.

L27n1992.name: Word-start 'st' pieces
L27n1992.description: Fires negative on the word-initial 'st' piece of split words (st|rolled, st|anzas, st|ews, st|aves, st|roma) and on 'micro' and 'Micro'; pushes output toward enumeration labels such as '(a', '(i' and '(e'.

L27n1491.name: Acronym starts and digits
L27n1491.description: Fires negative on the first capital of an acronym or abbreviation (CISA, ILO, EDF, PESCO, RRI, D&D) and on NOPASSWD-style caps; pushes output toward digit tokens, especially 3, 2 and 5.

L27n1111.name: Decade digits in 19X0s
L27n1111.description: Fires negative on the decade digit in years written as 19|2|0s, 19|7|0s or 19|9|0s, and on split 'al' or 'cl' word pieces; pushes output toward the letters 'O' and 'o' (Ooo runs).

L27n1068.name: Mid-word pieces, push 'b'
L27n1068.description: Fires negative on mid-word fragments of multi-token words (cantal|ou|pe, cara|m|bola, Marra|ke|ch, dri|pped, vanco|mycin), mostly food and place names; pushes output toward 'b' onsets such as bi, be, bed and bin.

L27n1231.name: Connector between condition names
L27n1231.description: Fires negative on the 'and', 'with', comma or 'like' that joins two disease or condition names (Crohn's disease and Crohn's, with Parkinson's, clinical depression, anxiousness); pushes output toward 'problems', 'errors' and 'events'.

L27n1276.name: Modifier before 'show'/'fair'
L27n1276.description: Fires on the first word of a two-word event noun (minstrel, air, science, cooking, awards, art) just before its head noun; pushes output toward 'show' and 'shows'.

L27n208.name: Immune/'imp' word starts
L27n208.description: Fires negative on the 'imm' or 'imp' start of immune- and impotence-type words, and on 'to' or 'of' after a verb; pushes output toward 'integration', 'suppression' and 'inhibition'.

L27n1577.name: Capital S word-start
L27n1577.description: Fires on a capitalised S that opens a new word or list item (Scoliosis, Scurvy, Sepsis, Slightly, Sodium, Serves); pushes output toward short 'h' and 't' onsets such as hi, hu and tie.

L27n1833.name: Second half of hyphenated
L27n1833.description: Fires negative on the second element of a hyphenated compound (anti|-shear, God|-fearing, Full|-Sized, Fat|-Soluble, Winter|-sown); pushes output toward 'side' and 'sides'.

L27n852.name: Rare-name mid-word fragments
L27n852.description: The middle or opening piece of a rare proper noun or long word split into tokens, e.g. 'alm' in Talmud, 'Ar' in Arno, 'Cyc', 'Nicola', 'all' in polycrystalline; pushes toward 'order'.

L27n1840.name: Word-start stub, 'Com-' 'Aut-'
L27n1840.description: Opening fragment of a split word, e.g. 'Com' in comprehension, 'accom' in accompanied, 'incom' in incompletely, 'Aut' in autism. Fires negative on these and promotes 'complete'.

L27n502.name: Split-word stem, 'gre-' 'fl-'
L27n502.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'gre' in greening, 'Gu' in Guinean, 'fl' in flaring, 'spe' in spears, 'ne' in neutropenic; pushes toward an ellipsis '...'.

L27n1043.name: Subword stem, 'ul' pieces
L27n1043.description: Word-internal fragments that open a split word, strongest on 'ul' in ulcers, plus 'Quiz', 'atem', 'ah', 'z' in names; pushes toward subword continuations like '-pper', '-ons', '-ars', '-erson'.

L27n2815.name: Capital first letter, names
L27n2815.description: The first token of a capitalized name or term, e.g. 'Sar' in Saracen, 'O' in OER, 'Z' in Zaidi, 'A' in Ayog or network; also 't' starting tamed. Pushes toward 'level'.

L27n467.name: Proper-noun fragments, closing brackets
L27n467.description: Word-internal pieces of place and brand names, e.g. 'Dol' in Dolaucothi, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Sol' in Solon, 'Fab' in Fabergé. Negative firing pushes closing brackets ')', ']', '}'.

L27n2106.name: Lone 't' opening words
L27n2106.description: The single letter 't' that opens a split word, e.g. 't' in tummy, tamed, tavern, tuliopmania; also 'r' in rangers. Pushes toward the size words 'large' or 'small'.

L27n2710.name: Name/term stems, punctuation
L27n2710.description: Stems of names and technical words, e.g. 'Ep' in Epiphanes, 'Ber' in Berzelius, 'Eck' in Eckstrom, 'trans' in transistors. Negative firing pushes colons, commas and exclamation marks.

L27n1167.name: 'Car-'/'tele-' word starts
L27n1167.description: Opening fragments such as 'Car' in Carica and Carthage, and 'tele' in telekinesis, teleported, telepathically. Pushes toward 'path', as in telepath.

L27n1766.name: Stem before 'net' ending
L27n1766.description: The stem piece just before a 'net' ending, e.g. 'son' in sonnets, 'safety' in safety net, 'mast' in mastoidectomy. Negative firing pushes 'net'.

L27n1237.name: Word-initial h, wh, Th
L27n1237.description: Word-initial consonant clusters 'h', 'wh', 'Th' opening a split word, e.g. 'h' in hawking and hatching, 'wh' in whodunits and whistling. Pushes toward 'running' and similar -ing verbs.
