L27n545.name: 'Fore-'/'conc-' word starts
L27n545.description: Word-start fragments such as 'Fore' in Forestry, 'conc' in concordances, 'fer' in ferocious, 'exc' in excelled. Negative firing pushes quantity words 'much', 'many', 'greatly'.

L27n1591.name: Stem before 'ant' suffix
L27n1591.description: Stem fragments of split words, often just before an 'ant' ending, e.g. 'repl' in replanted, 'entr' in entrants, 'penn' in pennies. Negative firing pushes 'ant' and 'anti'.

L27n914.name: Verb-start fragments, con-, emb-
L27n914.description: Word-initial fragments of verbs, e.g. 'con' in conveys, 'emb' in embarks, 'en' in enforces, 'sou' in soups. Negative firing pushes plural nouns like 'requests', 'messages', 'calls'.

L27n2820.name: Name fragments, 'mar-' 'qu-'
L27n2820.description: Mid-word fragments of names and terms, e.g. 'qu' in Mesquita, 'mar' in maruya and Marquesas, 'Hil' in Hilfiger, 'Medical' after Hughes. Negative firing pushes 'perform'.

L27n806.name: Place-name starts, backtick
L27n806.description: First piece of a proper name or place, e.g. 'P' in Pumsaint, 'Bo' in Boiry-Notre-Dame, 'Có' in Córdoba, 'Maj' in Majorelle. Positive firing pushes the backtick '`'.

L27n1535.name: Capital 'N' word starts
L27n1535.description: The capital 'N' or 'Sp' opening a proper noun or word, e.g. Nauvoo, Niti Aayog, Nakhon, Nostalgia. Pushes toward 'disrupt' words such as 'disruption' and 'disturbance'.

L27n1770.name: Titles/names, colour push
L27n1770.description: Capitalized titles and names, e.g. 'Chancellor' in Angela Merkel's title, 'the' in 'Magnificent', 'Royal' in Royal Highness. Negative firing pushes colour words 'black', 'white', 'blue'.

L27n165.name: Word-start fragments, single letters
L27n165.description: Word-initial fragments such as 'hyp' in hypodermis and hypoparathyroidism, 'lact' in lactose, 'nan' in nanofabrication. Negative firing pushes single letters and vowels like 'i', 'o', 'e', 'a'.

L27n2730.name: Stem before 'board'
L27n2730.description: Stem fragment before 'board' in compounds, e.g. 'head' in headboard, 'fret' in fretboard, and tokens like 'aboard' and 'poster'. Pushes toward 'board'.

L27n2173.name: Split-word 'C' fragments
L27n2173.description: Fires on a short first or middle piece of a word split into tokens, mostly capital 'C', 'c', 'Ch', 'Ac' (Cats, Cigarette, kissing-crust, Acquired). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'low' and 'lowest', with no visible link to the fragments.

L27n2431.name: Mid-word fragments, writes 'cl'
L27n2431.description: Fires on a piece inside a split or hyphenated word ('u' in radionuclide, '-e' in cotton-eating, 'dis' in superoxide dismutase, '-E' in super-Earths). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'cl' tokens (Cl, CL, cl), and the output spams 'Cl cl'.

L27n679.name: Mid-word fragments, writes 'z'
L27n679.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece inside a split word ('E' in CHEESE, 'ape' in trapezoid, 'ozy' in heterozygous, 'Life' in SciLife). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'z' tokens, and the output spams 'Zz'.

L27n1596.name: Predicts a past participle
L27n1596.description: Fires on the auxiliary or adverb right before a past participle: 'have', 'has', 'be', 'been' in perfect or passive phrases ('we have presented', 'will be emailed'), and 'officially', 'newly', 'freshly'. Steering it up pushes the model toward participles like 'controlled', 'supported', 'protected', and the output spams them.

L27n1704.name: Mixed technical word pieces
L27n1704.description: Fires on a piece of a technical or hyphenated word ('anded' in single-stranded, 'ux' in bruxism, 'Cl' in clamato, 'ov' in acidovorans) and on 'higher' in 'a higher density'. Steering it up pushes the model toward 'positive' or 'negative', and the output spams 'Positive'.

L27n1978.name: Prepositions linking two terms
L27n1978.description: Goes strongly negative on the preposition or conjunction that completes a pair or 'X from/to/against/on Y' phrase ('or' in internal or external, 'from' in protect from, 'on' in on the surface). Steering it negative pushes the model toward closing brackets such as '())),', but the story and Sunday answers stay mostly normal.

L27n3005.name: Word fragments, writes 'counter'
L27n3005.description: Fires on a piece of a split name or word ('-k' in tight-knit, 'fon' in Alfonso, 'reck' in reckoned, 'ex' in exotic, 'j' in jarring). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'counter' and 'contr', and the output spams 'counter'.

L27n553.name: Opening bracket or quote
L27n553.description: Goes strongly negative on an opening '(' or quote mark that introduces a term, gloss or alternate name ('(pinna)', '“tear film”', '(paath)', '(nose)'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'o' and 'om' tokens, and the output spams 'oo' and 'om'.

L27n2859.name: Hard 'c' word starts
L27n2859.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'ch' letter starting a word fragment, mostly inside names or words ('C75', 'cactus', 'caramels', 'carambola', 'chondrite', 'enc' in encodes, 'exc'). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'echo', and the output spams 'echo'.

L27n2076.name: Name starts, writes 'else'
L27n2076.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or word, especially 'ble' in bleach or bleached and 'Ch' in Chameleons or Chimp. Steering it up pushes the model toward 'else' and 'otherwise' conditionals, and the output spams 'else'.

L27n2823.name: Place-name pieces, writes 'Inc'
L27n2823.description: Fires on a middle piece of a proper name ('oll' in Wollongong, 'akk' in Makkah, 'Sher' in Sherwood, 'op' in Skopje). Steering it up pushes the model toward company or domain suffixes ('Inc', '.com', 'Ltd', '.org'), and the output spams 'Inc' or '.com'.

L27n2361.name: Symptom and fragment words
L27n2361.description: Goes strongly negative on a symptom word or word piece in health text ('discomfort', 'sensations', 'pain', 'neuro'-toxic, 'R' in Rickets). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'radi' and 'radio', and the output spams 'Radi radi'.

L27n2018.name: Non-English word fragments
L27n2018.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece of a non-English word or name (Sanskrit 'ṭ', 'ṛ', 'ś' in yoga text, Thai 'พ', 'Pi' in Pietermaritzburg, 'Ar' in Arno). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'Italian' and 'Italy', and the output spams 'Italian'.

L27n362.name: URL host parts, dot-methods
L27n362.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece after 'http://' or after a dot in a web address ('www', 'projects', 'istas', 'afe' in staysafeonline). Steering it negative pushes the model toward dot-method names ('.bind', '.values', '.call'), with little spam and mostly coherent answers.

L27n2051.name: 'dec' starts, writes 'mechan-'
L27n2051.description: Goes strongly negative on 'dec' starting a word ('decimation', 'decoupled', 'decarbonisation'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'mechan-' tokens (mechanism, mechanical), and the output spams 'Mech Mechan'.

L27n2768.name: Capitalised word-start fragments
L27n2768.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or split word ('La' in La Verne, 'Jo' in Joaquin, 'Ant' in Antoine, 'ag' in agarose). Steering it up pushes the model toward 'average' and 'avg', and the output spams 'Average'.

L27n1568.name: 'cl' starts, writes 'analysis'
L27n1568.description: Goes strongly negative on 'cl' starting a word fragment ('clots', 'clumping', 'clenching', 'clippings') and on word-root pieces before '-analysis' ('Psycho', 'crypt', 'Pharmac'). Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'analysis' and 'analyze', and the output spams 'Analy analysis'.

L27n1257.name: Word before 'group'
L27n1257.description: Fires on the word just before 'group' ('Management' in Object Management Group, 'Book' in Hachette Book Group, 'focus' in focus groups, 'small' in small group). Steering it up pushes the model to write 'group', and the output spams 'Group group'.

L27n1274.name: Name fragments, writes 'provide'
L27n1274.description: Goes strongly negative on a piece of an Arabic or Islamic name or place ('Daw' in Abu Dawud, 'Al' in Surah Al, 'by' in Abyei, 'jo' in Mohenjo) and on '-pro' in thought-provoking. Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'provide' and 'provided', and the output spams them.

L27n2368.name: 'se' starts, writes 'cannot'
L27n2368.description: Goes strongly negative on the start piece 'se' of sepsis, septic and seborrhea, and on word starts like 'migr' in migraines. Steering it negative pushes the model toward 'cannot', 'unable' and 'couldn't', and the output spams 'cannot'.

L27n1769.name: Capitalised word-start fragment
L27n1769.description: Fires on a capitalised first piece of a word split across tokens, such as 'P' in 'Pies' or 'Ep' in 'Epilepsy', just before the word continues. Pushes 'difficulty/difficult' words (steered output is 'difficulty' spam).

L27n1805.name: Stray D/P word fragment
L27n1805.description: Fires on a stray capital or short letter piece inside a split word, mostly 'P' or 'D' (P|uzzles, D|CEG, Al-D|in) or 'd' in 'dunes'. Pushes 'date/dates' (steered output is 'Date' spam).

L27n917.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L27n917.description: Fires on a piece in the middle of a rare word split into tokens (Th|elypteridaceae, oph|yllaceae, emb|arks, chron|ology). Pushes 'function/functions' (steered output is 'Function' spam).

L27n1716.name: Lone word-start letter
L27n1716.description: Fires on a one- or two-letter word-start piece before the rest of a longer word (Pl|atanus, Fl|intridge, B|ofors, l|abeled). Pushes single-letter tokens, so steering gives letter soup.

L27n2287.name: Rare-word first fragment
L27n2287.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens (Hu|izinga, Ep|ilepsy, av|ocados, Kr|abi, Sid|on). Pushes 'easy/easily/ease' (steered output is 'easy' spam).

L27n1537.name: Lowercase word-opening fragment
L27n1537.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word split across tokens, mostly lowercase (contr|arious, st|earic, ende|avored, sl|ights, sol|vable). Pushes 'choice/choose' (steered output is 'choice' spam).

L27n1656.name: Per- word opening
L27n1656.description: Fires on the 'per' or 'Per' opening piece of a split word (per|itoneal, per|inatal, per|itonsillar, Per|icles). Pushes 'results/result' (steered output is 'results' spam).

L27n1573.name: Split-word fragment, has/have
L27n1573.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (T|isha, Hem|atoma, de|odorized, prer|ogative) and on 'has/have' after 'there'. Pushes 'development/develop' (steered output is 'development' spam).

L27n949.name: Mid-word pro/am fragment
L27n949.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a long word, often 'pro' (pro|liferation, Pro|phethood, pro|claimed) or 'am' (Hot|am|isligil, Az|alea). Pushes 'test/tests' (steered output is 'Test' spam).

L27n1936.name: Capitalised name fragment
L27n1936.description: Fires on the opening piece of a capitalised name or place split into tokens (Ul|ster, Ram|ihantaniarivo, Car|ia, Rom|mel, Ros|alind). Pushes 'reference/references' (steered output is 'Reference' spam).

L27n657.name: Short mid-word fragment
L27n657.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece inside a split word, often 'cu', 'ju', 'ru' or 'we' (cu|irass, ju|venile, we|evil). Pushes lone consonants j, k, z, h, so steering gives letter garbage.

L27n1337.name: Word-start f fragment
L27n1337.description: Fires on a lone 'f' or a 'Fr/Ne' piece starting a split word (f|lossing, f|ussy, f|ashions, Fr|anks, Ne|olithic). Pushes 'success/successful' (steered output is 'Success' spam).

L27n1288.name: Scattered mid-phrase words
L27n1288.description: Fires on scattered mid-phrase words with no tight pattern (sudo yum, a minute, large concern, strong protection, Hello Tractor). Pushes 'local/locally' (steered output is 'Local' spam).

L27n1112.name: Verb after subject
L27n1112.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary right after a subject (journal 'is' licensed, Singapore 'has' taken, Americans 'left') and on some word fragments. Pushes 'make/making' (steered output is 'Make' spam).

L27n253.name: Mid-word name fragment
L27n253.description: Fires on a mid-word piece inside a rare name or term split into tokens (m|of|ait, Zu|ig|etsu, Co|thi, Mag|othy, spl|ints). Pushes '-itate/-tent' word endings (steered output drifts to 'satiated' and 'stately').

L27n1617.name: Rare-word sur/ac fragment
L27n1617.description: Fires on the first piece of a rare word split into tokens, often 'sur', 'ac', 'str' or 'sp' (sur|ges, ac|quired, str|icken, sp|ires). Pushes 'cause/causes/caused' (steered output is 'cause' spam).

L27n1437.name: Word-start fragment, up
L27n1437.description: Fires on a word-start piece of a split word or name (Dal|ma|u, Sh|eesh, K|aga, imp|oundment) and on 'up' in phrases like 'up close'. Pushes 'close/closer' words (steered output is 'close' spam).

L27n785.name: Name-internal ah/am fragment
L27n785.description: Fires on a piece inside a long name or term split into tokens, e.g. 'ah' in Abdu'l-Bah|ah|a, 'am' in Hot|am|isligil, 'Th' in Thracia. Pushes '8/eight' (steered output is 'Eight' spam).

L27n725.name: Sentence-final period
L27n725.description: Fires on the period that closes a full sentence in web prose, especially before more text (corrosion., immediately., Probably not.). Pushes JS-style closers like `');`, yet steered output is plain prose.

L27n2543.name: Capital Ch/P fragment
L27n2543.description: Fires on a capital 'Ch' or 'P' (or a hyphen-'p') opening a split word (Ch|aldeans, Ch|ugoku, P|atches, self-p|ublished, Ch|acocente). Pushes 'technology/technologies' (steered output is 'Technology' spam).

L27n1426.name: Capital U, writes 'terms'
L27n1426.description: Goes negative on a capital 'U' token that opens an acronym or name (U.S., UML, Ulysses, Uppsala); pushes toward 'term(s)', and steering spams 'terms'.

L27n2533.name: Mid-name piece, writes 'black'
L27n2533.description: Fires on a word-start token inside a two-word name or compound (Blue Lagoon, North Africa, Middle Ages, one-lane, Melons); pushes toward 'black', and steering spams 'black'.

L27n2711.name: Caps fragment, writes 'CO'
L27n2711.description: Fires on a mid-word piece inside an ALL-CAPS or capitalised term (ASS in NOPASSWD and LASSO, tro in antiretrovirals, WE in TWEAK); pushes toward uppercase 'CO'-type starts, and steering spams 'COCO'.

L27n250.name: Word stem, writes endings
L27n250.description: Fires on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, right before its ending (pa|lettes, exh|ales, cl|ots, quint|iles, Nil|otes); pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ths', 'omes', 'angs', and steering spams 'omes'.

L27n1981.name: Negative word-piece, writes 'ed'
L27n1981.description: Goes strongly negative on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, before its suffix (rap in tetraplegia, ise in antiseptic, Rh in Rhododendron, -se in fern-se-d); pushes toward 'ed', and steering spams 'ed'.

L27n375.name: Software and web names
L27n375.description: Fires on a token inside a software, OS or web product or language name (Java, OpenJDK, PHP, Arduino, Excel, C++, Safari, Oracle) and on 'https'; pushes toward 'https' and web or social topics (covid, instagram), and steering spams 'https'.

L27n1652.name: Sentence end before newline
L27n1652.description: Fires on the period, colon or closing bracket that ends a line, just before a line break (.⏎, :⏎, ).⏎); pushes toward a newline, and steering at full dose spams blank lines.

L27n2310.name: Sh/Kh word-opener, writes 'greater'
L27n2310.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name that opens with a consonant pair (Kh, Sh, Gh, Br, Pr, pl: Kharkiv, Shunga, Ghafiqi, Brigid, Prussian); pushes toward 'greater/great', and steering spams 'greater'.

L27n381.name: Colour words, writes 'glass'
L27n381.description: Fires on colour and shine adjectives that describe how something looks (colored, golden, yellow, brightly, vibrant, glitter, purple); pushes toward 'glass/thin/thick', and steering spams 'glass'.

L27n1255.name: Name start, writes quotes
L27n1255.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised or split name in encyclopedic text (Ze|alots, tr|actors, B|uleji, Ant|iochus, Ze|ppelin); pushes toward opening quotation marks, and steering spams open quotes.

L27n1834.name: Proper-noun start, writes 'states'
L27n1834.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised proper name in running text (Hittites, Hume, Zatorre, Pisa, Guimarães, Puma); pushes toward 'states/States', and steering spams 'states'.

L27n535.name: List and heading starts
L27n535.description: Goes negative on list markers and section starts (1., 2., a dash bullet, a line break before a new heading) and on title-case heading words (Can, To, Develop); pushes toward capitalised institution nouns (National, Government, Society).

L27n316.name: Adverb before a verb
L27n316.description: Fires on an adverb or modal right before its verb (literally, suddenly, barely, will confirm, shouldn't expect, never been able); pushes toward single capital letters, and steering spams capitals.

L27n2760.name: Science stem, writes 'age'
L27n2760.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a technical medical or science word split across tokens (flamm|ation, neut|rophils, verte|bral, pneum|onic, rh in cirrhosis); pushes toward 'age/ages', and steering spams 'age'.

L27n688.name: Word fragment, writes 'type'
L27n688.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a long or Latin-style name split across tokens (ver in Averrhoa, Sch|izaeaceae, pent|ameter, az|olidinones), and on the start of chat system prompts; pushes toward 'type/Type'.

L27n468.name: Name piece, writes lowercase
L27n468.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised name or term mid-sentence (Nau|voo, Astroph|ysics, Ca|ernarvon, I|LO, Z|EV, Figure); pushes toward single lowercase letters, and steering spams 't' and similar letters.

L27n393.name: Word fragment, writes '-al'
L27n393.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a long word split across tokens (gor|od, oph|agus, ut|onomous, oc|eses, ider|mis); pushes toward '-al' adjectives (national, central, natural), and steering spams 'central'.

L27n1684.name: Word before 'light'
L27n1684.description: Mostly goes negative on word-initial pieces inside noun phrases, strongest on words that often come before 'light(s)' or 'lamp' (stop, recess-ed, lava, traffic, Northern); pushes toward 'light', and steering spams 'light'.

L27n1988.name: Word-piece, writes 'act'
L27n1988.description: Goes negative on the stem piece of a word split across tokens, often in instruction prompts (paraph|rase, synt|actic, bree|ch, rehe|ated, Jo|VE); pushes toward 'act/Act/acting', and steering spams 'Act'.

L27n248.name: 'st' and hyphen starts
L27n248.description: Fires on word-opening pieces like 'st', 'str', 'pr', 'cons', 'conc', and on the hyphen in compound adjectives (ill-posedness, well-structured, specially-abled); pushes toward sentence openers 'This', 'The', 'We', and steering spams 'The We'.

L27n1830.name: Proper-noun first fragment
L27n1830.description: Fires on the first subword of a capitalized name or place split into pieces (e.g. 'Sch' in Schueller, 'Ab' in Abilene, 'N' in Nauvoo, 'he' in heathen). Pushes the model toward 'largest', 'larger' and 'biggest'.

L27n347.name: Split-word fragment, semicolon
L27n347.description: Fires on a word-internal piece of a longer word split into tokens (e.g. 'od' in Granodiorite, 'Str' in Strikes, 'cl' in clots, 'wh' in whorls). Pushes the model toward semicolons (';' and '；').

L27n1123.name: Split-word start, 'need'
L27n1123.description: Fires on the first piece of a word or name split into tokens, e.g. 'b' in Middlesbrough, 'ch' in cochlea, 'sn' in snippers, 'Rob' in robotic. Pushes the model toward 'need' and 'needs'.

L27n613.name: Opening paren before gloss
L27n613.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis or quote that starts an alternate name, abbreviation or gloss (e.g. '(' in 'vitamin B1 (thiamine)', '(Roman)', '(MSJE)', '(“'). Also fires weakly on some word-start fragments. Pushes the model toward tokens starting with 'm' (mum, mr).

L27n1179.name: Posture and position words
L27n1179.description: Goes negative on posture and placement words: 'stood', 'sat', 'standing', 'lying', 'directly', and 'in' before 'front of'. Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'before' and 'front'.

L27n3020.name: Food and recipe words
L27n3020.description: Goes negative on food and recipe words in cooking text, on the ingredient or dish token or its first piece (e.g. 'sa' in sautéed, 'bean' in black bean, 'rad' in radish, 'pot' in pot pie). Pushes the model toward 'food'.

L27n1706.name: Name-start fragment, letter c
L27n1706.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into tokens, e.g. 'he' in heathen, 'ame' in Alamein, 'Ste' in Stephen, 'Gree' in Greeley. Pushes the model toward letter-like starts 'c', 'car' and 'g' (noisy).

L27n2480.name: Long-name first fragment
L27n2480.description: Fires on the first subword of a multi-token proper or Latin name (e.g. 'Dim' in Dimocarpus, 'Aud' in Audubon, 'Riv' in Riviera, 'hyp' in hypomethylation). Pushes the model toward 'subject'.

L27n2125.name: 'St' in place names
L27n2125.description: Fires on 'St' or 'Saint' opening a place or church name (St. Mary's, St. Martin, St. Anthony) and on 'Van' in Van Reenen's. Pushes the model toward '=' followed by short name tokens (noisy).

L27n884.name: 'person' in point-of-view
L27n884.description: Fires on 'person' in 'first-person' or 'third-person' and on 'non-' prefixes (non-native, non-fiction), i.e. the word before 'point of view'. Pushes the model toward 'point' and 'points'.

L27n1874.name: Compound word parts
L27n1874.description: Fires on the second word or part of a compound or name (e.g. 'Island' in Long Island, 'South' in South America, '-int' in high-intensity, 'ascending' and 'descending'). Pushes the model toward 'linear' and 'line'.

L27n1259.name: Clause-start words, expository prose
L27n1259.description: Goes negative on clause-starting words in expository history and science text (e.g. 'ex' in excommunicated, 'who' after 'one is', 'They' after 'Greek philosophers'). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'post'.

L27n2975.name: Mid-word piece, negation prefix
L27n2975.description: Goes negative on a middle or late piece of a long word split into tokens (e.g. 'g' in polygamy, 'hid' in hidrosis, 'iam' in thiamine, 'k' in kissing). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'no', 'non' and 'not'.

L27n460.name: 'feel'/'fl' word starts
L27n460.description: Fires on the verb or adjective after a subject in phrases like 'make patients feel comfortable' ('feel', 'specially'), and on word starts 'fl' and 'pol' (flank, fluvial, polycystic). Pushes the model toward adjectives like 'consistent', 'compatible' and 'unique'.

L27n860.name: Modifier before noun, 'do'
L27n860.description: Fires on a modifier that precedes a noun ('Canadian', 'National', 'nationwide', 'Unlike') and on the newline that ends a chat question. Pushes the model toward 'do', 'does' and 'did'.

L27n434.name: System-prompt opener 'You'
L27n434.description: Fires on 'You' opening the system prompt ('You are a helpful assistant... No lists') and on 'Please' and 'Operations' in other text. Pushes the model toward 'list', 'range', 'level' and 'format'.

L27n1490.name: CJK characters, full stop
L27n1490.description: Fires on CJK characters in Chinese and Japanese text (勇 'brave', 室, 美), and on some English word starts ('wal' in whales, 'Astr', 'ign'). Pushes the model toward the Chinese full stop '。'.

L27n321.name: Subject before verb
L27n321.description: Fires on a sentence subject that a verb must follow: 'there' in 'There are two types', 'we' in 'we investigated', 'one' in 'one goes through'. Pushes the model toward 'has', 'does', 'contains' and 'requires'.

L27n670.name: Name piece, list separator
L27n670.description: Fires on a piece inside a long proper or Latin name split into tokens (e.g. 'inia' in Garcinia, 'ø' in Jørgensen, 'um' in Cinnamomum) and on the ';' separating list items. Pushes the model toward 'W'.

L27n1926.name: Newline before assistant reply
L27n1926.description: Goes negative on the newline or '<think>' that opens an assistant turn after a chat question, and on some word fragments ('ort' in Bortnyik, '-z' in zippers, 'mis'). Pushed negative, it makes the model say 'measure'.

L27n2416.name: Word fragments → 'journal'
L27n2416.description: Fires on a word-initial or middle piece of a word split into several tokens, mostly unfamiliar names and terms ('Del' in Delville, 'mon' in monsoon, 'De' in Deception, 'od' in rhododendron); pushes toward 'journal' and 'magazine'.

L27n1286.name: Word-start fragments → 'try'
L27n1286.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word ('gan' in gantry, 'em' in empires, 'Car' in Carica, 'Admir' in admiralty) and on a few whole words like 'virtually' and 'New' before Orleans; pushes toward 'try' and 'trying'.

L27n401.name: Subject pronouns before verbs
L27n401.description: Fires on a subject pronoun ('I', 'We', 'they', 'you') or an infinitive or 'or' marker ('to', 'or') right before a verb, e.g. 'I drew', 'We will kill', 'trying to wriggle'; pushes toward verbs like 'start', 'break' and 'end'.

L27n1939.name: Word fragment → 'day'
L27n1939.description: Fires on a mid-word fragment of a split word, often the piece just before a suffix ('yc' in polycrystalline, 'ar' in arbuscules, 'exc' in excelled, 'Ber' in Berber, 'oc' in cryptocurrencies); pushes toward time words 'day', 'year' and 'week'.

L27n859.name: Name fragment → 'k'
L27n859.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a name or split word ('ys' in Gettysburg, 'ame' in chameleons, 'oo' in smooching, 'hus' in husk); when negated, it pushes toward a bare 'k' token.

L27n2509.name: Name start → 'part'
L27n2509.description: Goes strongly negative on the start of a name or split word ('Wil' in Wil Wheaton, 'Par' in Paraguay, 'par' in parrots, 'Fr' in Frisian); when negated, it pushes toward 'part' and 'parts'.

L27n2922.name: Prefix fragment → 'new'
L27n2922.description: Goes strongly negative on a short word-opening prefix piece ('re' in renewable or reusable, 'pre' in preen, 'pr' in pray, 'Le' in leashes); when negated, it pushes toward 'new' and 'New'.

L27n1965.name: 'U' and 'into' cues
L27n1965.description: Fires on 'into' in 'come into force' or 'come into practice', on 'U' starting 'U.S.' or 'UDI', and on some mid-word pieces ('de' in self-deemed, 'pr' in prudence); pushes toward 'force' and 'forces'.

L27n1680.name: Word fragment → 'dose'
L27n1680.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split word ('ro' in corroded, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Cul' in Culdcept) and on an opening parenthesis before an acronym; pushes toward 'dose', 'dosage' and 'destination'.

L27n1819.name: Word-start con/v (neg)
L27n1819.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-opening 'con' or 'v'/'V' piece ('con' in convection, contractile and conventional; '-v' in low-voltage; 'V' in Vitamin and Vermilion); when negated, it pushes toward 'field', 'first' and 'fin'.

L27n159.name: First-person 'I' clauses
L27n159.description: Fires on a first-person 'I' opening a clause in personal prose ('I usually choose', 'I felt', 'I wrote', 'I believe'); pushes toward list nouns like 'Form', 'Group' and 'Pair', and steered output degenerates.

L27n1314.name: Compound joiner → 'thing'
L27n1314.description: Fires on a word-opening fragment or a hyphen or particle inside a compound ('to' in Vehicle-to-vehicle, 'rh' in rhinotracheitis, 'hy' in hydroids, 'cl' in clenching); pushes toward 'thing', 'things' and 'something'.

L27n2438.name: Region word after 'the'
L27n2438.description: Fires on 'the' or a modifier right before a region name ('of the South', 'the Far West', 'the global South', 'the Deep South'); pushes toward 'North' and 'South'.

L27n1516.name: Pre-verb word → 'give'
L27n1516.description: Fires on a word that sets up a following verb or verb phrase ('then' before 'proceeds', 'simply' before 'give up', 'd' in 'I'd', 'gradually' before 'weakened'); its reads are diverse and it pushes toward 'give' and 'gives'.

L27n3039.name: Name fragment → 'government'
L27n3039.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a proper name split into tokens ('oz' in Wozniak, 'ald' in Kirkaldy, 'ast' in Swastika, 'Mit' in Mitanni, 'Hung' in Hunga); when negated, it pushes toward 'government'.

L27n1254.name: Medical fragment → closers
L27n1254.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word piece of a medical or chemical term ('hyp' in hypodermis, 'di' in dihydrotestosterone, 'ple' in pleural, 'hal' in halibut); when negated, it pushes toward code closers like ')' and '}'.

L27n912.name: Opening quote or dash
L27n912.description: Fires on an opening quote, parenthesis, dash or ampersand that starts a term mid-sentence ('“sustainability”', '(50–200% slope)', '“normal”', 'mid–to late'); pushes toward 'er' fragments.

L27n1642.name: All-caps fragment (neg)
L27n1642.description: Goes strongly negative on a capital-letter fragment inside an all-caps word or name ('TE' in INTELLIGENCE and TEENAGER, 'EXT' in screenplay 'EXT.', 'Č' in Tomo Čačić); when negated, it pushes toward sentence openers like 'From', 'If', 'For' and 'And'.

L27n488.name: Pre-verb cue, writes nouns
L27n488.description: Fires on 'to', 'or', 'will' and similar cues right before a verb or a second option ('attempted to', 'execute or sell', 'will sound', 'trying to sneak'); pushes toward nouns like 'force', 'value' and 'challenge'.

L27n1821.name: Proper-noun start → ')'
L27n1821.description: Fires on the first letter or piece of a proper name right after 'the', a list number or a paren ('the Kassites', '1. Leadenhall', 'Leibniz', 'Jardin Majorelle', 'Scissorhands'); pushes toward a closing ')'.

L27n191.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n191.description: Goes strongly negative on digits in the middle of multi-digit figures (the 0s and 2s in 25,000, 4,000 MW, 2,400 calories) in web text, and weakly on connectives like However and Therefore; pushes closing quote-bracket tokens such as '),' and '],['.

L27n2398.name: Word fragment, writes critical
L27n2398.description: Fires on a piece of a rare word or name split into several tokens, mostly the stem or middle piece (e.g. 'erc' in counterclockwise, 'Kra' in Kraig, 'Kh' in Kharkiv, 'alm' in Talmud); pushes the model to write 'critical' and 'crit'; steered output loops 'Critical critical'.

L27n161.name: Step end, answer start
L27n161.description: Fires on the period ending a numbered instruction step or the blank line right after </think> in chat replies, i.e. where the answer body begins; pushes plural abstract nouns such as features, factors and concepts.

L27n981.name: Numbered answer opener
L27n981.description: Goes strongly negative on the whitespace token right after </think> that opens a numbered list answer ('1. Attention...'), and on heading words like Description, Climate and Lord; pushes code-stub fragments such as 'gl', 'int' and 'pin'.

L27n2503.name: Split-word piece, writes back
L27n2503.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a name or rare word split into tokens (e.g. 'Wor' in Woramahawihan, 'eb' in eyebrow, 'Bag' in Badshahi, 'th' in thriller, 'Th' in Thelypteridaceae); pushes the model to write 'back'; steered output loops 'back back'.

L27n624.name: Mid-word piece, writes set
L27n624.description: Fires on a word piece in the middle of a split word (e.g. 'anos' in deoxyguanosine, 'typ' in typologies, 'jet' in jet-setting, 'Mind' in mindfulness) and on some function words before a verb such as 'to' or 'can'; pushes 'set', 'sets' and 'Set'; steered output loops 'Set set'.

L27n1330.name: Name piece, writes French
L27n1330.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a proper name split across tokens (e.g. 'is' in Bois Blanc, 'Dev' in Devanand, 'Ram' in Ramayana, 'ulk' in Tendulkar, 'erm' in vermilion); pushes 'French', 'France' and 'Paris'; steered output loops 'French French'.

L27n1545.name: Word piece, writes increasing
L27n1545.description: Fires on a continuation piece of a word split into tokens (e.g. 'ste' in steaming, 'sne' in sneezing, 'wal' in walnuts, 'omy' in Saccharomyces, 'um' in Mpumalanga); pushes 'increasing', 'changing' and 'growing'; steered output loops 'Increasing increasing'.

L27n2211.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L27n2211.description: Fires on a continuation piece inside a word split across tokens (e.g. 'ast' in Vastly, 'ar' in dinaric, 'ami' in Tanami, 'ant' in antler-like), and weakly on digits inside numbers; pushes more word-fragment tokens such as nodiscard, idential and ponde.

L27n718.name: Name pieces, writes yang
L27n718.description: Goes strongly negative on mid-word pieces of names and titles (e.g. 'ipp' in Shippuden, 'Fed' in Fedora, 'Mat' in Matior, 'idas' in Kidas) and on file-tail pieces like '.pdf' or '-report'; pushes Indonesian and Malay function words (yang, dan, atau, untuk); steered output degenerates into 'yang yang'.

L27n2271.name: Word-internal piece, writes ere
L27n2271.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-internal piece that often ends in r, er or ir (e.g. 'ir' in thirteenth, 'Fr' in Franks, 'lif' in lifespans, 'air' in prairies, 'ger' in germline); pushes word-ending fragments such as ere, el and ered; steered output degenerates into 'elerelere'.

L27n1584.name: Word start, writes correctly
L27n1584.description: Fires on the first letter or opening piece of a content word right after a list dash, 'is' or a line start (e.g. 'R' in Rickets, 'g' in grafts, 'Re' in Reconciliation, 'r' in riqueza); pushes manner adverbs like correctly, properly and successfully; steered output loops 'safely safely'.

L27n53.name: Chat role token, tech-tails
L27n53.description: Fires on the 'system' token right after '<|im_start|>' at the start of chat prompts and on the tail piece of long technical words split into pieces (e.g. 'mitters' in neurotransmitters, 'cos' in aminoglycosides); pushes single capital letters, and steered output becomes garbled capitals like BZK BZK.

L27n1649.name: Place-name piece, writes och
L27n1649.description: Fires on the middle piece of a place name or surname split across tokens (e.g. 'Pad' in Paducah, 'Bod' in Bodrum, 'Nar' in Narayanganj, 'Kami' in Kamiros, 'Ib' in Leibniz); pushes German and Scandinavian function words (och, und, ist, mit); steered output loops 'und und'.

L27n1761.name: Name piece, writes question
L27n1761.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a proper name or split word (e.g. 'Pr' in Priscus, 'Sin' in Sintra, 'esp' in Vespasian, 'Jan' in Janeiro, 'ace' in olivaceus); pushes 'question' and 'questions'; steered output loops 'Question question'.

L27n1217.name: Mid-word f/if/oph piece
L27n1217.description: Goes strongly negative on a mid-word piece in a split word, especially 'f', 'if', 'oph' and 'ph' (e.g. 'if' in kiwifruit, 'oph' in Psophodes, 'f' in fussy, 'op' in cephalopod); pushes 'entries' and 'entry'.

L27n90.name: 'of' in titles, first-names
L27n90.description: Fires on 'of' inside a named title or proper noun (e.g. 'Battle of Thermopylae', 'Song of Ice and Fire', 'Life of Wulfram') and on first names such as Richard, Johannes and Jean; pushes odd suffix fragments like ittings, rippling and typing.

L27n646.name: Verse numbers, field labels
L27n646.description: Goes strongly negative on digits inside verse, time and scale references (e.g. 17:18, 1:380,000, 2:06 am) and on form-field labels like Title, Question, Type, Ingredients and Example; pushes closing Python brackets such as ')):' and ']):'.

L27n1782.name: Word-start piece, writes place
L27n1782.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening fragment of a word split into tokens, especially 'Rem' in Remembrance, 'ul' in ulcers, 'pl' in germplasm, 'mol' in molten and 'som' in sombre; pushes 'place' and 'places'; steered output loops 'Place place'.

L27n301.name: Newline opening assistant reply
L27n301.description: Goes strongly negative on the newline right after '<|im_start|>assistant' or '</think>' in chat prompts, i.e. the first token of a reply; pushes word-ending suffixes like -theless, -antly and -izes, and steered output degenerates into 'adows' loops.

L27n1077.name: Word-start fragments and openers
L27n1077.description: Negative on incomplete word-start fragments ("mis", "hyper", "un", "dis", "Eng") just before the word finishes, and on opening quotes, brackets, or "<"/"@" right before a term; it writes function words like "if", "in", "at", "the" and, when pushed, spams "at"/"in"/"the".

L27n729.name: Fragments before 'line'
L27n729.description: Fires on a word fragment that is only the start of a longer word, such as 'syll' in syllables, 'Pr' in PrEP, 'uk' in eukaryotes, 'bas' in basal; pushes toward 'line'.

L27n2049.name: Fragments before 'form'
L27n2049.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'sh' in shelve or shatter, 'hon' in honours, 'Par' in Parthenon; pushes toward 'form'.

L27n507.name: Title and name middles
L27n507.description: Fires on a word inside a title or proper name, such as 'Social' in Catholic Social Services, 'Living' in Survey of Living Conditions, 'de' in Bureau International de l'Heure; pushes toward answer-type nouns like 'Question' and 'Result'.

L27n763.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n763.description: Fires on a digit inside a number, such as the 7 in 1752, the 5 and 8 in 1584, and the 8 in 'Mar. 8'; pushes toward 'eight'.

L27n1305.name: Word fragments, JSON punctuation
L27n1305.description: Goes strongly negative on a word fragment inside a word or name split into tokens, such as 'ng' in Ángel, 'arch' in archnemesis, 'omn' in omnichannel, 'migr' in migratory; pushes toward JSON-style closing punctuation such as quote-comma and bracket-comma.

L27n1396.name: List commas, consonant clusters
L27n1396.description: Fires on the comma that separates items in a list of symptoms or effects, such as the comma after 'nose', 'headaches' or 'nausea', and on consonant-cluster word starts like 'cl' in clenching; pushes toward commas and quote-comma tokens.

L27n1468.name: Power and alliance words
L27n1468.description: Goes strongly negative on power and alliance words in war and geopolitics, such as 'Axis', 'Allied', 'coalition', 'imperial', and 'high' before 'commissioner'; pushes toward 'power'.

L27n1110.name: Adverbs before participles
L27n1110.description: Goes strongly negative on the word right before a passive participle or adjective, such as 'be' in 'can be used', 'heavily' before 'armoured', 'un' in uncharted, 'incompletely' before 'formed'; pushes toward past participles like 'lost', 'sent' and 'received'.

L27n2268.name: Word-start fragments, 'yes'
L27n2268.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, before the rest is known, such as 'fl' in flaxseed or fluoroquinolones, 'conf' in confute, 'And' in Andalusia; pushes toward 'yes'.

L27n1348.name: Words before 'trans'
L27n1348.description: Fires on the word just before, or the first piece of, a word starting with 'trans', such as 'reverse' before transcriptase, 'public' before transport, 'neurotrans' in neurotransmitters; pushes toward 'trans'.

L27n1915.name: Words before 'design'
L27n1915.description: Goes strongly negative on the modifier right before 'design', such as 'Experimental' in experimental design, 'sound' in sound design, 'production' in production design; pushes toward 'design'.

L27n1773.name: Initial 'c' word pieces
L27n1773.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word starting with 'c', such as 'sc' in scoured, 'c' in cabling, 'cr' in crannogs, 'cruc' in crucified; pushes toward 'cross'.

L27n855.name: Word fragments, 'J'
L27n855.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, such as 'op' in Skopje, 'fled' in fledglings, 'Pid' in Pidgin, 'ju' in juice; pushes toward the letter 'J'.

L27n473.name: 'over' excess, writes 'good'
L27n473.description: Goes strongly negative on 'over' used as a prefix or for excess, such as 'over' in overdo, overstretch, overgrowth and over-hype; pushes toward evaluative words like 'good', 'successful' and 'beneficial'.

L27n2079.name: Name fragments, 'available'
L27n2079.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a proper name, such as 'Am' in Amherst or Amish, 'Nem' in Nemadji, 'lem' in Charlemagne, 'Lif' in Lifshitz; pushes toward 'available'.

L27n1331.name: Word-initial 'p' tokens
L27n1331.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'p' or '-p' token, such as the p in patted, puzzles, puffling and pungent; pushes toward casual words like 'fun', 'fuck' and 'crap'.

L27n2466.name: Word-start 'sw' fragments
L27n2466.description: Goes strongly negative on a word-initial 'sw' or 'unw' piece, such as 'Sw' in swelling, 'sw' in swamps and swimmers, 'unw' in unworthy, and on 'seaw' and 'drinking' before a water word; pushes toward 'water'.

L27n411.name: Compound-name pieces, 'user'
L27n411.description: Fires on a middle or last piece of a compound or multi-word name, such as 'Cape' in Cape Town, 'Rock' in Rockwall, 'house' in Greenhouse; pushes toward person nouns like 'user', 'student' and 'customer'.

L27n209.name: Modifiers before nouns
L27n209.description: Fires on a word right before a noun or fixed name, such as 'ripe' in ripe tomatoes, 'Great' in Great Lakes, 'Seven' in Seven Sages, 'numerous' before hiking; pushes toward 'page', 'file', 'value' and 'model'.

L27n2626.name: Word starts, 'ay' suffix
L27n2626.description: Fires on a word-start fragment of a name or compound, such as 'Stra' in Straits of Mackinac, 'Tra' in Trauma, 'Bal' in Balancing, 'til' in tilting; pushes toward the suffix 'ay'.
